## Test Strategy (TDD)

Write tests **first**, then implement. Each test must fail with a clear "missing item" error before the implementation lands.

### SSR tests — Heading (`crates/ars-leptos/tests/heading.rs`)

```rust
#![cfg(all(not(target_arch = "wasm32"), feature = "ssr"))]

use ars_leptos::utility::heading::{Heading, HeadingLevelProvider, Section, Level};
use leptos::prelude::*;

#[test]
fn heading_renders_h1_by_default() {
    let html = view! { <Heading id="title">"Hello"</Heading> }.to_html();
    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with("<h1"));
    for f in [r#"id="title""#, r#"data-ars-scope="heading""#, r#"data-ars-part="root""#, "Hello"] {
        assert!(html.contains(f), "missing {f}: {html}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn heading_explicit_level_overrides_default() {
    let html = view! { <Heading id="t" level=Level::Three>"Three"</Heading> }.to_html();
    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with("<h3"));
}

#[test]
fn section_increments_inherited_level() {
    let html = view! {
        <Section>
            <Heading id="nested">"Two"</Heading>
        </Section>
    }.to_html();
    assert!(html.contains("<h2"), "Section should bump default Level::One to Level::Two: {html}");
}

#[test]
fn heading_level_provider_sets_starting_level() {
    let html = view! {
        <HeadingLevelProvider level=Level::Four>
            <Heading id="four">"Four"</Heading>
        </HeadingLevelProvider>
    }.to_html();
    assert!(html.contains("<h4"));
}

#[test]
fn nested_sections_clamp_at_six() {
    let html = view! {
        <Section><Section><Section><Section><Section><Section>
            <Heading id="deep">"Six"</Heading>
        </Section></Section></Section></Section></Section></Section>
    }.to_html();
    assert!(html.contains("<h6"));
}

#[test]
fn heading_without_id_does_not_emit_generated_id() {
    let html = view! { <Heading>"Hello"</Heading> }.to_html();
    assert!(!html.contains("id="), "passive Heading should not emit id=: {html}");
}

#[test]
fn heading_explicit_level_overrides_inherited_context() {
    let html = view! {
        <HeadingLevelProvider level=Level::Four>
            <Heading id="explicit" level=Level::Two>"Two"</Heading>
        </HeadingLevelProvider>
    }.to_html();
    assert!(html.contains("<h2"));
}
```

### SSR tests — Landmark (`crates/ars-leptos/tests/landmark.rs`)

Cover one assertion per `Role`: native element rendered + correct `aria-label` (from a stub `Messages { label }`), no `role` attr for native elements, fallback `<div role="search">` for `Search`, `aria-labelledby` precedence, missing-name path emits no `aria-label`.

```rust
#![cfg(all(not(target_arch = "wasm32"), feature = "ssr"))]
use ars_core::MessageFn;
use ars_leptos::utility::landmark::{Landmark, Messages, Role};
use leptos::prelude::*;

fn messages(label: &'static str) -> Messages {
    Messages { label: MessageFn::static_str(label) }
}

#[test]
fn landmark_navigation_renders_native_nav_with_aria_label() {
    let html = view! {
        <Landmark id="nav" role=Role::Navigation messages=messages("Primary navigation")>
            "links"
        </Landmark>
    }.to_html();
    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with("<nav"));
    assert!(html.contains(r#"aria-label="Primary navigation""#));
    assert!(!html.contains(r#"role="navigation""#), "native nav must not emit explicit role: {html}");
}

#[test]
fn landmark_search_falls_back_to_div_with_explicit_role() {
    let html = view! {
        <Landmark id="search" role=Role::Search messages=messages("Site search")>
            "form"
        </Landmark>
    }.to_html();
    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with("<div"));
    assert!(html.contains(r#"role="search""#));
}

#[test]
fn landmark_labelledby_takes_precedence_over_aria_label() {
    let html = view! {
        <Landmark id="r" role=Role::Region labelledby_id="ext" messages=messages("ignored")>
            "x"
        </Landmark>
    }.to_html();
    assert!(html.contains(r#"aria-labelledby="ext""#));
    assert!(!html.contains(r#"aria-label="ignored""#), "labelledby must suppress aria-label: {html}");
}

// Repeat one test per native role (Banner→header, Main→main, Complementary→aside,
// ContentInfo→footer, Form→form, Region→section) — assert tag, data-ars-scope, and
// either aria-label or absence-of-aria-label-when-missing.
```

### SSR tests — Highlight (`crates/ars-leptos/tests/highlight.rs`)

```rust
#![cfg(all(not(target_arch = "wasm32"), feature = "ssr"))]
use ars_leptos::utility::highlight::{Highlight, MatchStrategy};
use leptos::prelude::*;

#[test]
fn highlight_wraps_match_in_mark() {
    let html = view! {
        <Highlight query=vec!["world".into()] text="Hello world!".into() />
    }.to_html();
    for f in [
        r#"data-ars-scope="highlight""#,
        r#"data-ars-part="root""#,
        r#"dir="auto""#,
        r#"<mark"#,
        r#"data-ars-part="highlight-chunk""#,
        r#"data-ars-highlighted="true""#,
        ">world<",
    ] {
        assert!(html.contains(f), "missing {f}: {html}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn highlight_non_matched_chunks_use_span() {
    let html = view! {
        <Highlight query=vec!["world".into()] text="Hello world!".into() />
    }.to_html();
    assert!(html.contains(r#"data-ars-highlighted="false""#));
    assert!(html.matches("<span").count() >= 2, "should contain root span + unmatched chunk spans: {html}");
}

#[test]
fn highlight_empty_query_renders_single_unmatched_chunk() {
    let html = view! { <Highlight query=Vec::<String>::new() text="Hello".into() /> }.to_html();
    assert!(!html.contains("<mark"));
    assert!(html.contains("Hello"));
}

#[test]
fn highlight_ignore_case_default_matches_uppercase_query() {
    let html = view! {
        <Highlight query=vec!["WORLD".into()] text="Hello world!".into() />
    }.to_html();
    assert!(html.contains("<mark"), "case-insensitive match expected: {html}");
}

#[test]
fn highlight_starts_with_strategy_only_matches_prefix() {
    let html = view! {
        <Highlight
            query=vec!["world".into()]
            text="Hello world!".into()
            match_strategy=MatchStrategy::StartsWith
        />
    }.to_html();
    // "world" is not a prefix of "Hello world!", so no <mark>.
    assert!(!html.contains("<mark"), "StartsWith should not match mid-string: {html}");
}
```

## Step-by-Step Execution Order

Recommend executing per-component in this sequence to keep the diff reviewable and tests green at every commit. Each "phase" maps to one TDD cycle (red → green → refactor → commit) — every commit must `cargo check -p <crate>` clean.

1. **Phase A — Leptos Heading + providers** (issue #324, half-scope)
   1. Add module + prelude wiring stubs (`pub mod heading;` + tuple update) so the test files compile against re-exports.
   2. Write `tests/heading.rs` (SSR) — 7 tests as above. Run `cargo test -p ars-leptos --features ssr heading`. Confirm tests FAIL.
   3. Implement `src/utility/heading.rs` (Heading + HeadingLevelProvider + Section). Run the test command again — all pass.
   4. Write `tests/heading_wasm.rs` (3 wasm tests). Run `cargo test -p ars-leptos --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features web heading_wasm`. Pass.
   5. Commit message: `feat(leptos): add Heading, HeadingLevelProvider, Section adapters (#324)`. **No commit yet — wait for the user's approval per workspace convention.**

2. **Phase B — Leptos Landmark** (issue #324, half-scope)
   1. Add `pub mod landmark;` + prelude.
   2. Write `tests/landmark.rs` (SSR; one assertion per role + labelledby precedence + missing-name fallback). Confirm FAIL.
   3. Implement `src/utility/landmark.rs`. Pass.
   4. Write `tests/landmark_wasm.rs`.

3. **Phase C — Leptos Highlight** (issue #328)
   1. Add `pub mod highlight;` + prelude.
   2. Write `tests/highlight.rs` (SSR; matches, non-matches, empty query, ignore_case, StartsWith). Confirm FAIL.
   3. Implement `src/utility/highlight.rs`. Pass.
   4. Write `tests/highlight_wasm.rs`.

4. **Phase D — Dioxus Heading + providers** (issue #419, half-scope)
5. **Phase E — Dioxus Landmark** (issue #419, half-scope)
6. **Phase F — Dioxus Highlight** (issue #421)

Phases D-F mirror A-C 1:1 with Dioxus syntax.

7. **Phase G — Post-implementation audit (MANDATORY)** — Invoke the `post-implementation-audit` skill (CLAUDE.md §7) on the six new component files + their test files. Run all three audits sequentially:
   - **a)** spec/implementation drift against the six adapter spec files in `spec/leptos-components/utility/` and `spec/dioxus-components/utility/`,
   - **b)** ≥ 2 rounds of "anything else missing?",
   - **c)** test-coverage audit for unit/snapshot/proptest/spec-conformance/llvm-cov.
   - Every finding lands in this PR — no deferral.

8. **Phase H — Validation (run sequentially, each must be green)**
   - `cargo test -p ars-leptos --features ssr` — SSR tests pass.
   - `cargo test -p ars-leptos --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features web` — wasm tests pass (requires `wasm-pack` if not already installed via `cargo install wasm-pack --version 0.13.1`; matches the `a11y-audit` job convention).
   - `cargo test -p ars-dioxus` — SSR + native tests pass.
   - `cargo test -p ars-dioxus --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features web` — wasm tests pass.
   - `cargo xci --profile fast` (alias `cargo xci-fast`) from repo root — covers fmt, clippy, unit, integration, adapter, spec-compile-snippets, error-variant-coverage, mutual-exclusion, snapshot-count. **Must pass before pushing.**

9. **Phase I — Commit + push (only after user approval)** — Single commit with co-author footer, then `gh pr create` targeting `main` with body including `Closes #324`, `Closes #328`, `Closes #419`, `Closes #421`. No snapshot files are expected from this work, but if any `.snap` files appear, add the `snapshot-reviewed` label.

10. **Phase J — Wait for Codex review (MANDATORY)** — Invoke the `waiting-for-codex-review` skill, address any threads with the same rigor as `post-implementation-audit`, repush, re-comment `@codex review`, loop until Codex leaves 👍.

## Risks / Edge Cases to Watch

- **Locale signal mid-life updates** — Leptos `use_locale()` returns a signal; `Landmark::Api::new(props, env, messages)` snapshots the locale once. If the user changes locale post-mount, the rendered `aria-label` will not update unless we move the `Api` construction into a `Memo`. For this PR's scope (stateless utility, parity with the canonical sketches), one-shot construction is correct per spec §7 "render-time only, no post-mount sync expected". If a downstream component needs reactive locale, we revisit then — not now.
- **Heading context default** — When `use_context::<HeadingContext>()` returns `None`, default to `HeadingContext::new()` (Level::One). Do NOT panic.
- **Highlight chunk borrow** — `Api::chunks(&locale)` returns chunks borrowing from `props.text`. The current `props` lives inside the function; clone each `chunk.text` to an owned `String` before constructing the view (cheap — most chunks are short and we are not in a hot path).
- **Dioxus rsx returns under `match`** — Dioxus 0.7 supports returning `rsx! { … }` from each arm directly as `Element`. No need for unifying types.
- **`leptos::either::EitherOf*` availability** — Leptos 0.8 ships `Either`, `EitherOf3`…`EitherOfN` up to `EitherOf16`. If a specific arity is missing during implementation, use the next higher size (e.g., `EitherOf8` with one unused variant, marked `unreachable!()`) rather than `AnyView`. Confirm imports via the **leptos** skill before writing code that depends on these types — claudes' training data on Leptos APIs is stale.
- **Locale read pattern** — both `ars_leptos::use_locale()` and `ars_dioxus::use_locale()` return `Signal<Locale>` (verified). Leptos reads with `.get()`; Dioxus reads with `.read().clone()`. Use the canonical "use prop if present, else snapshot from signal" pattern from `crates/ars-dioxus/src/provider.rs:418` so locale-prop overrides work uniformly.
- **Search role** — `<search>` is intentionally NOT used; the agnostic core's `prefers_generic_fallback_element()` already signals this; we honor it by rendering `<div role="search">`.
- **No snapshot files expected** — These adapters render plain HTML attribute strings, so `.to_html()` and `dioxus_ssr::render` assertions use direct string matching. No `insta` fixtures should be created. If any `.snap` files appear in the diff, re-examine — they likely indicate accidental adoption of snapshot tests in adapter crates (those belong in the agnostic core).

120	    /// Decorative separators get `role="none"` (the modern WAI-ARIA 1.2
121	    /// preferred form, synonymous with `role="presentation"`); they omit
122	    /// `aria-orientation` and the `data-ars-orientation` styling hook,
123	    /// because a decorative separator is invisible to assistive technology
124	    /// and component-managed orientation styling is not applied.
125	    #[must_use]
126	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
127	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
128	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();
129	
130	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val).set(part_attr, part_val);
131	
132	        if self.props.decorative {
133	            // Decorative separators are removed from the accessibility tree
134	            // via `role="none"`. No `aria-hidden` (redundant for an element
135	            // with no children) and no `data-ars-orientation` (decorative
136	            // separators do not participate in component orientation styling).
137	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "none");
138	        } else {
139	            let orientation_str = match self.props.orientation {
140	                Orientation::Horizontal => "horizontal",
141	                Orientation::Vertical => "vertical",
142	            };
143	
144	            attrs
145	                .set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-orientation"), orientation_str)
146	                .set(HtmlAttr::Role, "separator")
147	                .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Orientation), orientation_str);
148	        }
149	
150	        attrs
151	    }
152	}

```
    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();

        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val).set(part_attr, part_val);

        if self.props.is_focusable {
            // Element is visible when focused, hidden otherwise. Do not also
            // set `ars-visually-hidden`; that class hides unconditionally
            // and would break the focus-visible behavior.
            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-visually-hidden-focusable"), true);
        } else {
            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Class, "ars-visually-hidden");
        }

        attrs
    }
}

[`HeadingLevelProvider`] and [`Section`] provider components so descendants\n//! receive an updated `HeadingContext` without prop drilling.\n\npub use ars_components::utility::heading::{\n    Api, HeadingContext, Level, Part, Props, heading_level_provider, section,\n};\nuse ars_core::{AttrValue, HtmlAttr};\nuse leptos::{\n    either::EitherOf6,\n    prelude::*,\n};\n\nuse crate::attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs;\n\nfn root_attrs(id: Option<String>, level: Option<Level>, ctx: HeadingContext) -> Vec<crate::LeptosAttribute> {\n    let mut props = Props::new();\n\n    if let Some(id) = id.clone() {\n        props = props.id(id);\n    }\n\n    if let Some(level) = level {\n        props = props.level(level);\n    }\n\n    let api = Api::new(props, ctx);\n    let mut attrs = api.root_attrs(true);\n\n    if id.is_none() {\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, AttrValue::None);\n    }\n\n    attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(attrs)\n}\n\n/// Reads the inherited heading level context, defaulting to [`HeadingContext::new`]\n/// (level one) when no provider is in scope.\nfn inherited_context() -> HeadingContext {\n    use_context::<HeadingContext>().unwrap_or_default()\n}\n\n/// Leptos `Heading` component.\n///\n/// Renders a semantic `<h1>`–`<h6>` element whose level is resolved from the\n/// explicit `level` prop, the nearest [`HeadingContext`] published by\n/// [`HeadingLevelProvider`] or [`Section`], or [`Level::One`] when no provider\n/// is in scope.\n#[component]\npub fn Heading(\n    /// Optional component instance ID.\n    #[prop(optional, into)]\n    id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,\n\n    /// Explicit heading level override; when absent, the nearest\n    /// [`HeadingContext`] supplies the resolved level.\n    #[prop(optional)]\n    level: Option<Level>,\n\n    /// Heading content rendered inside the resolved tag.\n    children: Children,\n) -> impl IntoView {\n    let id = id.map(Oco::into_owned);\n    let ctx = inherited_context();\n    let mut props = Props::new();\n\n    if let Some(id) = id.clone() {\n        props = props.id(id);\n    }\n\n    if let Some(level) = level {\n        props = props.level(level);\n    }\n\n    let resolved = Api::new(props, ctx).resolved_level();\n    let attrs = root_attrs(id, level, ctx);\n\n    match resolved {\n        Level::One => EitherOf6::A(view! { <h1 {..attrs}>{children()}</h1> }),\n        Level::Two => EitherOf6::B(view! { <h2 {..attrs}>{children()}</h2> }),\n        Level::Three => EitherOf6::C(view! { <h3 {..attrs}>{children()}</h3> }),\n        Level::Four => EitherOf6::D(view! { <h4 {..attrs}>{children()}</h4> }),\n        Level::Five => EitherOf6::E(view! { <h5 {..attrs}>{children()}</h5> }),\n        Level::Six => EitherOf6::F(view! { <h6 {..attrs}>{children()}</h6> }),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Leptos `HeadingLevelProvider` component.\n///\n/// Provider-only component that publishes a starting [`HeadingContext`] to its\n/// descendants. Renders no DOM of its own.\n#[component]\npub fn HeadingLevelProvider(\n    /// Starting heading level to publish to descendants.\n    level: Level,\n\n    /// Descendants that should observe the published [`HeadingContext`].\n    children: Children,\n) -> impl IntoView {\n    let provider_props = heading_level_provider::Props::new().level(level);\n    provide_context(heading_level_provider::context_for(&provider_props));\n    children()\n}\n\n/// Leptos `Section` component.\n///\n/// Provider-only component that publishes an incremented [`HeadingContext`] to\n/// its descendants, clamped at [`Level::Six`]. Renders no DOM of its own.\n#[component]\npub fn Section(\n    /// Descendants that should observe the incremented [`HeadingContext`].\n    children: Children,\n) -> impl IntoView {\n    let parent = inherited_context();\n    provide_context(section::context_for(&parent));\n    children()\n}\n"
}

SSR tests for the Leptos `Heading` adapter.\n\n#![cfg(all(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"), feature = \"ssr\"))]\n\nuse ars_leptos::utility::heading::{Heading, HeadingLevelProvider, Level, Section};\nuse leptos::prelude::*;\n\n#[test]\nfn heading_renders_h1_by_default() {\n    let html = view! { <Heading id=\"title\">\"Hello\"</Heading> }.to_html();\n\n    assert!(\n        html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<h1\"),\n        \"default Heading should render an h1 root: {html}\"\n    );\n\n    for fragment in [\n        r#\"id=\"title\"\"#,\n        r#\"data-ars-scope=\"heading\"\"#,\n        r#\"data-ars-part=\"root\"\"#,\n        \"Hello\",\n    ] {\n        assert!(html.contains(fragment), \"missing {fragment}: {html}\");\n    }\n\n    assert!(\n        !html.contains(r#\"role=\"heading\"\"#),\n        \"native heading element must not emit explicit role: {html}\"\n    );\n\n    assert!(\n        !html.contains(\"aria-level\"),\n        \"native heading element must not emit aria-level: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn heading_explicit_level_overrides_default() {\n    let html = view! { <Heading id=\"three\" level=Level::Three>\"Three\"</Heading> }.to_html();\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<h3\"), \"expected h3 root: {html}\");\n    assert!(html.contains(r#\"id=\"three\"\"#));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn heading_renders_each_level_one_through_six() {\n    let cases = [\n        (Level::One, \"<h1\"),\n        (Level::Two, \"<h2\"),\n        (Level::Three, \"<h3\"),\n        (Level::Four, \"<h4\"),\n        (Level::Five, \"<h5\"),\n        (Level::Six, \"<h6\"),\n    ];\n\n    for (level, expected_tag) in cases {\n        let html = view! { <Heading level=level>\"Level\"</Heading> }.to_html();\n\n        assert!(\n            html.trim_start().starts_with(expected_tag),\n            \"expected {expected_tag} for {level:?}: {html}\"\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn heading_without_id_does_not_emit_id_attr() {\n    let html = view! { <Heading>\"Hello\"</Heading> }.to_html();\n\n    assert!(\n        !html.contains(\"id=\"),\n        \"passive Heading must not emit id=: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn heading_level_provider_publishes_starting_level() {\n    let html = view!   "content": "//! Browser coverage tests for the Leptos `Heading` adapter.\n\n#![cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")]\n\nuse ars_leptos::utility::heading::{Heading, HeadingLevelProvider, Level, Section};\nuse leptos::{mount::mount_to, prelude::*};\nuse wasm_bindgen::JsCast;\nuse wasm_bindgen_test::{wasm_bindgen_test, wasm_bindgen_test_configure};\n\nwasm_bindgen_test_configure!(run_in_browser);\n\nfn document() -> web_sys::Document {\n    web_sys::window()\n        .and_then(|window| window.document())\n        .expect(\"document should exist\")\n}\n\nfn container() -> web_sys::HtmlElement {\n    let element = document()\n        .create_element(\"div\")\n        .expect(\"container should be created\");\n\n    document()\n        .body()\n        .expect(\"body should exist\")\n        .append_child(&element)\n        .expect(\"container should be attached\");\n\n    element\n        .dyn_into::<web_sys::HtmlElement>()\n        .expect(\"container should be an HtmlElement\")\n}\n\n#[wasm_bindgen_test(async)]\nasync fn heading_browser_resolves_explicit_levels_and_attrs() {\n    let owner = Owner::new();\n\n    let (_mount_handle, parent) = owner.with(|| {\n        let parent = container();\n\n        let mount_handle = mount_to(parent.clone(), || {\n            view! {\n                <Heading id=\"h-default\">\"Default\"</Heading>\n                <Heading id=\"h-three\" level=Level::Three>\"Three\"</Heading>\n                <Heading id=\"h-six\" level=Level::Six>\"Six\"</Heading>\n            }\n        });\n\n        (mount_handle, parent)\n    });\n\n    leptos::task::tick().await;\n\n    let default = parent\n        .query_selector(\"#h-default\")\n        .expect(\"query should succeed\")\n        .expect(\"default Heading root should exist\");\n\n    assert_eq!(default.tag_name(), \"H1\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        default.get_attribute(\"data-ars-scope\").as_deref(),\n        Some(\"heading\")\n    );\n    assert_eq!(\n        default.get_attribute(\"data-ars-part\").as_deref(),\n        Some(\"root\")\n    );\n    assert_eq!(default.get_attribute(\"role\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(default.get_attribute(\"aria-level\"), None);\n\n    let three = parent\n        .query_selector(\"#h-three\")\n        .expect(\"query should succeed\")\n        .expect(\"Heading level=3 root should exist\");\n\n    assert_eq!(three.tag_name(), \"H3\");\n\n    let six = parent\n        .query_selector(\"#h-six\")\n        .expect(\"query should succeed\")\n        .expect(\"Heading level=6 root should exist\");\n\n    assert_eq!(six.tag_name(), \"H6\");\n\n    parent.remove();\n}\n\n#[wasm_bindgen_test(async)]\nasync fn heading_browser_inherits_provider_and_section_context() {\n    let owner = Owner::new();\n\n    let (_mount_handle, parent) = owner.with(|| {\n        let parent = container();\n\n        let mount_handle = mount_to(parent.clone(), || {\n            view! {\n                <HeadingLevelProvider level=Level::Two>\n                    <Heading id=\"provided\">\"Two\"</Heading>\n                    <Section>\n                        <Heading id=\"section-child\">\"Three\"</Heading>\n                    </Section>\n                </HeadingLevelProvider>\n            }\n        });\n\n        (mount_handle, parent)\n    });\n\n    leptos::task::tick().await;\n\n    let provided = parent\n        .query_selector(\"#provided\")\n        .expect(\"query should succeed\")\n        .expect(\"provided Heading root should exist\");\n\n    assert_eq!(provided.tag_name(), \"H2\");\n\n    let section_child = parent\n        .query_selector(\"#section-child\")\n        .expect(\"query should succeed\")\n        .expect(\"section-child Heading root should exist\");\n\n    assert_eq!(section_child.tag_name(), \"H3\");\n\n    parent.remove();\n}\n\n#[wasm_bindgen_test(async)]\nasync fn heading_browser_passive_root_has_no_id_attr() {\n    let owner = Owner::new();\n\n    let (_mount_handle, parent) = owner.with(|| {\n        let parent = container();\n\n        let mount_handle = mount_to(parent.clone(), || {\n            view! { <Heading>\"No id\"</Heading> }\n        });\n\n        (mount_handle, parent)\n    });\n\n    leptos::task::tick().await;\n\n    let heading = parent\n        .query_selector(\"h1[data-ars-scope='heading']\")\n        .expect(\"query should succeed\")\n        .expect(\"passive Heading root should exist\");\n\n    assert_eq!(heading.get_attribute(\"id\"), None);\n\n    parent.remove();\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//! Leptos `Landmark` adapter.\n//!\n//! Renders the framework-agnostic [`Landmark`](ars_components::utility::landmark)\n//! attribute contract as a semantic landmark element selected from the\n//! configured [`Role`], falling back to `<div role=\"…\">` when no native\n//! landmark element applies (currently only [`Role::Search`]).\n\npub use ars_components::utility::landmark::{Api, Messages, Part, Props, Role};\nuse ars_core::{AttrValue, Env, HtmlAttr};\nuse leptos::{\n    either::{Either, EitherOf7},\n    prelude::*,\n};\n\nuse crate::{attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs, use_locale};\n\n/// Leptos `Landmark` component.\n///\n/// Renders a semantic landmark element (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`,\n/// `<aside>`, `<footer>`, `<form>`, `<section>`) for the requested\n/// [`Role`], or an explicit `<div role=\"search\">` fallback when\n/// [`Api::prefers_generic_fallback_element`] returns `true`. Reads the\n/// locale from the surrounding [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) context\n/// when resolving the localized `aria-label` from `messages`.\n#[component]\npub fn Landmark(\n    /// Optional component instance ID.\n    #[prop(optional, into)]\n    id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,\n\n    /// Semantic landmark role. Defaults to [`Role::Region`].\n    #[prop(optional)]\n    role: Option<Role>,\n\n    /// Optional ID of an external element that labels this landmark. When\n    /// set and non-empty, `aria-labelledby` takes precedence over the\n    /// localized `aria-label`.\n    #[prop(optional, into)]\n    labelledby_id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,\n\n    /// Localized messages bundle (currently only `label`). Defaults to an\n    /// empty label, which suppresses `aria-label` and triggers the\n    /// development-mode \"missing accessible name\" warning for roles that\n    /// require one.\n    #[prop(optional)]\n    messages: Option<Messages>,\n\n    /// Children rendered inside the landmark element.\n    children: Children,\n) -> impl IntoView {\n    let resolved_role = role.unwrap_or(Role::Region);\n    let mut props = Props::new().role(resolved_role);\n\n    if let Some(id) = id.as_deref() {\n        props = props.id(id);\n    }\n\n    if let Some(labelledby) = labelledby_id.as_deref() {\n        props = props.labelledby_id(labelledby);\n    }\n\n    let messages = messages.unwrap_or_default();\n    let env = Env {\n        locale: use_locale().get(),\n        ..Env::default()\n    };\n    let api = Api::new(props, &env, &messages);\n    let is_native = !api.prefers_generic_fallback_element();\n    let mut attrs = api.root_attrs(is_native);\n\n    if id.is_none() {\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, AttrValue::None);\n    }\n\n    let attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(attrs);\n\n    if !is_native {\n        Either::Left(view! { <div {..attrs}>{children()}</div> })\n    } else {\n        Either::Right(match resolved_role {\n            Role::Banner => EitherOf7::A(view! { <header {..attrs}>{children()}</header> }),\n            Role::Navigation => EitherOf7::B(view! { <nav {..attrs}>{children()}</nav> }),\n            Role::Main => EitherOf7::C(view! { <main {..attrs}>{children()}</main> }),\n            Role::Complementary => EitherOf7::D(view! { <aside {..attrs}>{children()}</aside> }),\n            Role::ContentInfo => EitherOf7::E(view! { <footer {..attrs}>{children()}</footer> }),\n            Role::Form => EitherOf7::F(view! { <form {..attrs}>{children()}</form> }),\n            Role::Region => EitherOf7::G(view! { <section {..attrs}>{children()}</section> }),\n            Role::Search => unreachable!(\n                \"Role::Search is handled by Api::prefers_generic_fallback_element()\"\n            ),\n        })\n    }\n}\n"
}

1	//! Leptos `Landmark` adapter.
2	//!
3	//! Renders the framework-agnostic [`Landmark`](ars_components::utility::landmark)
4	//! attribute contract as a semantic landmark element selected from the
5	//! configured [`Role`], falling back to `<div role="…">` when no native
6	//! landmark element applies (currently only [`Role::Search`]).
7	
8	pub use ars_components::utility::landmark::{Api, Messages, Part, Props, Role};
9	use ars_core::{AttrValue, Env, HtmlAttr};
10	use leptos::{
11	    either::{Either, EitherOf7},
12	    prelude::*,
13	};
14	
15	use crate::{attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs, use_locale};
16	
17	/// Leptos `Landmark` component.
18	///
19	/// Renders a semantic landmark element (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`,
20	/// `<aside>`, `<footer>`, `<form>`, `<section>`) for the requested
21	/// [`Role`], or an explicit `<div role="search">` fallback when
22	/// [`Api::prefers_generic_fallback_element`] returns `true`. Reads the
23	/// locale from the surrounding [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) context
24	/// when resolving the localized `aria-label` from `messages`.
25	#[component]
26	pub fn Landmark(
27	    /// Optional component instance ID.
28	    #[prop(optional, into)]
29	    id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
30	
31	    /// Semantic landmark role. Defaults to [`Role::Region`].
32	    #[prop(optional)]
33	    role: Option<Role>,
34	
35	    /// Optional ID of an external element that labels this landmark. When
36	    /// set and non-empty, `aria-labelledby` takes precedence over the
37	    /// localized `aria-label`.
38	    #[prop(optional, into)]
39	    labelledby_id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
40	
41	    /// Localized messages bundle (currently only `label`). Defaults to an
42	    /// empty label, which suppresses `aria-label` and triggers the
43	    /// development-mode "missing accessible name" warning for roles that
44	    /// require one.
45	    #[prop(optional)]
46	    messages: Option<Messages>,
47	
48	    /// Children rendered inside the landmark element.
49	    children: Children,
50	) -> impl IntoView {
51	    let resolved_role = role.unwrap_or(Role::Region);
52	    let mut props = Props::new().role(resolved_role);
53	
54	    if let Some(id) = id.as_deref() {
55	        props = props.id(id);
56	    }
57	
58	    if let Some(labelledby) = labelledby_id.as_deref() {
59	        props = props.labelledby_id(labelledby);
60	    }
61	
62	    let messages = messages.unwrap_or_default();
63	    let env = Env {
64	        locale: use_locale().get(),
65	        ..Env::default()
66	    };
67	    let api = Api::new(props, &env, &messages);
68	    let is_native = !api.prefers_generic_fallback_element();
69	    let mut attrs = api.root_attrs(is_native);
70	
71	    if id.is_none() {
72	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, AttrValue::None);
73	    }
74	
75	    let attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(attrs);
76	
77	    if !is_native {
78	        Either::Left(view! { <div {..attrs}>{children()}</div> })
79	    } else {
80	        Either::Right(match resolved_role {
81	            Role::Banner => EitherOf7::A(view! { <header {..attrs}>{children()}</header> }),
82	            Role::Navigation => EitherOf7::B(view! { <nav {..attrs}>{children()}</nav> }),
83	            Role::Main => EitherOf7::C(view! { <main {..attrs}>{children()}</main> }),
84	            Role::Complementary => EitherOf7::D(view! { <aside {..attrs}>{children()}</aside> }),
85	            Role::ContentInfo => EitherOf7::E(view! { <footer {..attrs}>{children()}</footer> }),
86	            Role::Form => EitherOf7::F(view! { <form {..attrs}>{children()}</form> }),
87	            Role::Region => EitherOf7::G(view! { <section {..attrs}>{children()}</section> }),
88	            Role::Search => {
89	                unreachable!("Role::Search is handled by Api::prefers_generic_fallback_element()")
90	            }
91	        })
92	    }
93	}
94

SSR tests for the Leptos `Landmark` adapter.\n\n#![cfg(all(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"), feature = \"ssr\"))]\n\nuse ars_core::MessageFn;\nuse ars_leptos::utility::landmark::{Landmark, Messages, Role};\nuse leptos::{prelude::*, reactive::owner::Owner};\n\nfn render(view_fn: impl FnOnce() -> String + 'static) -> String {\n    let owner = Owner::new();\n    let result = owner.with(view_fn);\n    drop(owner);\n    result\n}\n\nfn messages(label: &'static str) -> Messages {\n    Messages {\n        label: MessageFn::static_str(label),\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_region_renders_section_with_aria_label() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Landmark id=\"region\" messages=messages(\"Activity\")>\n                \"content\"\n            </Landmark>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(\n        html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<section\"),\n        \"default Landmark should render a section root: {html}\"\n    );\n\n    for fragment in [\n        r#\"id=\"region\"\"#,\n        r#\"data-ars-scope=\"landmark\"\"#,\n        r#\"data-ars-part=\"root\"\"#,\n        r#\"aria-label=\"Activity\"\"#,\n    ] {\n        assert!(html.contains(fragment), \"missing {fragment}: {html}\");\n    }\n\n    assert!(\n        !html.contains(r#\"role=\"region\"\"#),\n        \"native section landmark must not emit explicit role: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_banner_renders_native_header() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Landmark id=\"b\" role=Role::Banner messages=messages(\"Site banner\")>\"top\"</Landmark>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<header\"), \"expected <header>: {html}\");\n    assert!(!html.contains(r#\"role=\"banner\"\"#));\n    assert!(html.contains(r#\"aria-label=\"Site banner\"\"#));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_navigation_renders_native_nav() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Landmark\n                id=\"n\"\n                role=Role::Navigation\n                messages=messages(\"Primary navigation\")\n            >\"links\"</Landmark>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<nav\"));\n    assert!(!html.contains(r#\"role=\"navigation\"\"#));\n    assert!(html.contains(r#\"aria-label=\"Primary navigation\"\"#));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_main_renders_native_main() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Landmark id=\"m\" role=Role::Main>\"main\"</Landmark>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<main\"));\n    assert!(!html.contains(r#\"role=\"main\"\"#));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_complementary_renders_native_aside() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Landmark\n                id=\"c\"\n                role=Role::Complementary\n                messages=messages(\"Related\")\n            >\"side\"</Landmark>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<aside\"));\n    assert!(!html.contains(r#\"role=\"complementary\"\"#));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_content_info_renders_native_footer() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Landmark id=\"f\" role=Role::ContentInfo>\"footer\"</Landmark>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<footer\"));\n    assert!(!html.contains(r#\"role=\"contentinfo\"\"#));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_form_renders_native_form() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Landmark\n                id=\"form\"\n                role=Role::Form\n                messages=messages(\"Account settings\")\n            >\"fields\"</Landmark>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<form\"));\n    assert!(!html.contains(r#\"role=\"form\"\"#));\n    assert!(html.contains(r#\"aria-label=\"Account settings\"\"#));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_search_falls_back_to_div_with_explicit_role() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Landmark\n                id=\"search\"\n                role=Role::Search\n                messages=messages(\"Site search\")\n            >\"input\"</Landmark>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(\n        html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<div\"),\n        \"Search must use a div fallback: {html}\"\n    );\n    assert!(html.contains(r#\"role=\"search\"\"#));\n    assert!(html.contains(r#\"aria-label=\"Site search\"\"#));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_labelledby_takes_precedence_over_aria_label() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Landmark\n                id=\"r\"\n                role=Role::Region\n                labelledby_id=\"external-label\"\n                messages=messages(\"ignored\")\n            >\"content\"</Landmark>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(html.contains(r#\"aria-labelledby=\"external-label\"\"#));\n    assert!(\n        !html.contains(r#\"aria-label=\"#),\n        \"labelledby must suppress aria-label: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_without_id_does_not_emit_id_attr() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! Renders the framework-agnostic [`Highlight`](ars_components::utility::highlight)\n//! attribute contract as a `<span>` root that wraps alternating\n//! highlighted / non-highlighted chunks. Highlighted chunks render as\n//! `<mark>`; non-highlighted chunks render as `<span>`. Locale resolves\n//! from the optional `locale` prop or the surrounding\n//! [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) context.\n\npub use ars_components::utility::highlight::{Api, HighlightChunk, MatchStrategy, Part, Props};\nuse ars_i18n::Locale;\nuse leptos::{either::Either, prelude::*};\n\nuse crate::{attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs, use_locale};\n\n/// Leptos `Highlight` component.\n///\n/// Splits `text` into chunks according to the configured `query`,\n/// `ignore_case`, and `match_strategy`, rendering each chunk as either a\n/// `<mark>` (highlighted) or `<span>` (unmatched). The root `<span>`\n/// receives `data-ars-scope=\"highlight\"`, `data-ars-part=\"root\"`, and\n/// `dir=\"auto\"` from the agnostic core.\n#[component]\npub fn Highlight(\n    /// Search queries to highlight. Empty (or all-empty) input emits a\n    /// single non-highlighted chunk.\n    #[prop(optional, into)]\n    query: Vec<String>,\n\n    /// Source text to split into highlighted / non-highlighted chunks.\n    #[prop(optional, into)]\n    text: String,\n\n    /// When `true` (default), matching is case-insensitive via\n    /// locale-aware Unicode case folding.\n    #[prop(optional)]\n    ignore_case: Option<bool>,\n\n    /// Match strategy. Defaults to [`MatchStrategy::Contains`].\n    #[prop(optional)]\n    match_strategy: Option<MatchStrategy>,\n\n    /// Optional locale override. When absent, the locale is sourced from\n    /// the surrounding [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) context.\n    #[prop(optional)]\n    locale: Option<Locale>,\n) -> impl IntoView {\n    let props = Props::new()\n        .query(query)\n        .text(text)\n        .ignore_case(ignore_case.unwrap_or(true))\n        .match_strategy(match_strategy.unwrap_or_default());\n\n    let api = Api::new(props);\n    let locale = locale.unwrap_or_else(|| use_locale().get());\n\n    let root_attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(api.root_attrs());\n\n    let chunks = api\n        .chunks(&locale)\n        .into_iter()\n        .map(|chunk| {\n            let chunk_attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(api.chunk_attrs(chunk.highlighted));\n            let text = chunk.text.to_owned();\n\n            if chunk.highlighted {\n                Either::Left(view! { <mark {..chunk_attrs}>{text}</mark> })\n            } else {\n                Either::Right(view! { <span {..chunk_attrs}>{text}</span> })\n            }\n        })\n        .collect_view();\n\n    view! { <span {..root_attrs}>{chunks}</span> }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//! Browser coverage tests for the Leptos `Highlight` adapter.\n\n#![cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")]\n\nuse ars_leptos::utility::highlight::{Highlight, MatchStrategy};\nuse leptos::{mount::mount_to, prelude::*};\nuse wasm_bindgen::JsCast;\nuse wasm_bindgen_test::{wasm_bindgen_test, wasm_bindgen_test_configure};\n\nwasm_bindgen_test_configure!(run_in_browser);\n\nfn document() -> web_sys::Document {\n    web_sys::window()\n        .and_then(|window| window.document())\n        .expect(\"document should exist\")\n}\n\nfn container() -> web_sys::HtmlElement {\n    let element = document()\n        .create_element(\"div\")\n        .expect(\"container should be created\");\n\n    document()\n        .body()\n        .expect(\"body should exist\")\n        .append_child(&element)\n        .expect(\"container should be attached\");\n\n    element\n        .dyn_into::<web_sys::HtmlElement>()\n        .expect(\"container should be an HtmlElement\")\n}\n\n#[wasm_bindgen_test(async)]\nasync fn highlight_browser_wraps_matched_chunks_in_mark_elements() {\n    let owner = Owner::new();\n\n    let (_mount_handle, parent) = owner.with(|| {\n        let parent = container();\n\n        let mount_handle = mount_to(parent.clone(), || {\n            view! {\n                <Highlight\n                    query=vec![\"world\".to_string()]\n                    text=\"Hello world!\".to_string()\n                />\n            }\n        });\n\n        (mount_handle, parent)\n    });\n\n    leptos::task::tick().await;\n\n    let root = parent\n        .query_selector(\"span[data-ars-scope='highlight']\")\n        .expect(\"query should succeed\")\n        .expect(\"highlight root should exist\");\n\n    assert_eq!(\n        root.get_attribute(\"data-ars-part\").as_deref(),\n        Some(\"root\")\n    );\n    assert_eq!(root.get_attribute(\"dir\").as_deref(), Some(\"auto\"));\n\n    let mark = parent\n        .query_selector(\"mark[data-ars-highlighted='true']\")\n        .expect(\"query should succeed\")\n        .expect(\"highlighted chunk should be a <mark>\");\n\n    assert_eq!(mark.text_content().as_deref(), Some(\"world\"));\n\n    parent.remove();\n}\n\n#[wasm_bindgen_test(async)]\nasync fn highlight_browser_unmatched_chunks_use_spans() {\n    let owner = Owner::new();\n\n    let (_mount_handle, parent) = owner.with(|| {\n        let parent = container();\n\n        let mount_handle = mount_to(parent.clone(), || {\n            view! {\n                <Highlight\n                    query=vec![\"world\".to_string()]\n                    text=\"Hello world!\".to_string()\n                />\n            }\n        });\n\n        (mount_handle, parent)\n    });\n\n    leptos::task::tick().await;\n\n    let unmatched = parent\n        .query_selector(\"span[data-ars-highlighted='false']\")\n        .expect(\"query should succeed\")\n        .expect(\"unmatched chunk should exist as <span>\");\n\n    assert!(\n        matches!(unmatched.text_content().as_deref(), Some(\"Hello \") | Some(\"!\")),\n        \"unexpected unmatched chunk text: {:?}\",\n        unmatched.text_content()\n    );\n\n    parent.remove();\n}\n\n#[wasm_bindgen_test(async)]\nasync fn highlight_browser_starts_with_strategy_does_not_match_mid_string() {\n    let owner = Owner::new();\n\n    let (_mount_handle, parent) = owner.with(|| {\n        let parent = container();\n\n        let mount_handle = mount_to(parent.clone(), || {\n            view! {\n                <Highlight\n                    query=vec![\"world\".to_string()]\n                    text=\"Hello world!\".to_string()\n                    match_strategy=MatchStrategy::StartsWith\n                />\n            }\n        });\n\n        (mount_handle, parent)\n    });\n\n    leptos::task::tick().await;\n\n    let mark = parent\n        .query_selector(\"mark\")\n        .expect(\"query should succeed\");\n\n    assert!(\n        mark.is_none(),\n        \"StartsWith match strategy must not produce a <mark> when query is mid-string\"\n    );\n\n    parent.remove();\n}\n"
}

14	fn root_attrs(id: Option<&str>, orientation: Orientation, decorative: bool) -> Vec<Attribute> {
15	    let mut props = Props::new().orientation(orientation).decorative(decorative);
16	
17	    if let Some(id) = id {
18	        props = props.id(id);
19	    }

24	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, id);
25	    }
26	
27	    attr_map_to_dioxus_inline_attrs(attrs)
28	}

76	#[component]
77	pub fn SeparatorAsChild(props: SeparatorAsChildProps) -> Element {
78	    let attrs = root_attrs(props.id.as_deref(), props.orientation, props.decorative);
79	
80	    props.render.call(AsChildRenderProps { attrs })
81	}

  "content": "//! Dioxus `Heading` adapter.\n//!\n//! Renders the framework-agnostic [`Heading`](ars_components::utility::heading)\n//! attribute contract as a semantic `<h1>`–`<h6>` element whose level resolves\n//! from explicit props or the inherited [`HeadingContext`]. Ships alongside\n//! [`HeadingLevelProvider`] and [`Section`] provider components so descendants\n//! receive an updated `HeadingContext` without prop drilling.\n\npub use ars_components::utility::heading::{\n    Api, HeadingContext, Level, Part, Props, heading_level_provider, section,\n};\nuse ars_core::{AttrValue, HtmlAttr};\nuse dioxus::prelude::*;\n\nuse crate::attr_map_to_dioxus_inline_attrs;\n\nfn inherited_context() -> HeadingContext {\n    try_use_context::<HeadingContext>().unwrap_or_default()\n}\n\n/// Props for the Dioxus [`Heading`] component.\n#[derive(Props, Clone, PartialEq, Debug)]\npub struct HeadingProps {\n    /// Optional component instance ID.\n    #[props(optional, into)]\n    pub id: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Explicit heading level override; when absent, the nearest\n    /// [`HeadingContext`] supplies the resolved level.\n    #[props(optional)]\n    pub level: Option<Level>,\n\n    /// Heading content rendered inside the resolved tag.\n    pub children: Element,\n}\n\n/// Dioxus `Heading` component.\n///\n/// Renders a semantic `<h1>`–`<h6>` element whose level is resolved from the\n/// explicit `level` prop, the nearest [`HeadingContext`] published by\n/// [`HeadingLevelProvider`] or [`Section`], or [`Level::One`] when no provider\n/// is in scope.\n#[component]\npub fn Heading(props: HeadingProps) -> Element {\n    let ctx = inherited_context();\n    let mut core_props = Props::new();\n\n    if let Some(id) = props.id.as_deref() {\n        core_props = core_props.id(id);\n    }\n\n    if let Some(level) = props.level {\n        core_props = core_props.level(level);\n    }\n\n    let api = Api::new(core_props, ctx);\n    let resolved = api.resolved_level();\n    let mut attrs = api.root_attrs(true);\n\n    if props.id.is_none() {\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, AttrValue::None);\n    }\n\n    let attrs = attr_map_to_dioxus_inline_attrs(attrs);\n    let children = props.children;\n\n    match resolved {\n        Level::One => rsx! { h1 { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Level::Two => rsx! { h2 { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Level::Three => rsx! { h3 { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Level::Four => rsx! { h4 { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Level::Five => rsx! { h5 { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Level::Six => rsx! { h6 { ..attrs, {children} } },\n    }\n}\n\n/// Props for the Dioxus [`HeadingLevelProvider`] component.\n#[derive(Props, Clone, PartialEq, Debug)]\npub struct HeadingLevelProviderProps {\n    /// Starting heading level to publish to descendants.\n    pub level: Level,\n\n    /// Descendants that should observe the published [`HeadingContext`].\n    pub children: Element,\n}\n\n/// Dioxus `HeadingLevelProvider` component.\n///\n/// Provider-only component that publishes a starting [`HeadingContext`] to its\n/// descendants. Renders no DOM of its own.\n#[component]\npub fn HeadingLevelProvider(props: HeadingLevelProviderProps) -> Element {\n    let provider_props = heading_level_provider::Props::new().level(props.level);\n    use_context_provider(|| heading_level_provider::context_for(&provider_props));\n    rsx! { {props.children} }\n}\n\n/// Props for the Dioxus [`Section`] component.\n#[derive(Props, Clone, PartialEq, Debug)]\npub struct SectionProps {\n    /// Descendants that should observe the incremented [`HeadingContext`].\n    pub children: Element,\n}\n\n/// Dioxus `Section` component.\n///\n/// Provider-only component that publishes an incremented [`HeadingContext`] to\n/// its descendants, clamped at [`Level::Six`]. Renders no DOM of its own.\n#[component]\npub fn Section(props: SectionProps) -> Element {\n    let parent = inherited_context();\n    use_context_provider(|| section::context_for(&parent));\n    rsx! { {props.children} }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//! Dioxus `Landmark` adapter.\n//!\n//! Renders the framework-agnostic [`Landmark`](ars_components::utility::landmark)\n//! attribute contract as a semantic landmark element selected from the\n//! configured [`Role`], falling back to `<div role=\"…\">` when no native\n//! landmark element applies (currently only [`Role::Search`]).\n\npub use ars_components::utility::landmark::{Api, Messages, Part, Props, Role};\nuse ars_core::{AttrValue, Env, HtmlAttr};\nuse dioxus::prelude::*;\n\nuse crate::{attr_map_to_dioxus_inline_attrs, use_locale};\n\n/// Props for the Dioxus [`Landmark`] component.\n#[derive(Props, Clone, PartialEq, Debug)]\npub struct LandmarkProps {\n    /// Optional component instance ID.\n    #[props(optional, into)]\n    pub id: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Semantic landmark role. Defaults to [`Role::Region`].\n    #[props(default = Role::Region)]\n    pub role: Role,\n\n    /// Optional ID of an external element that labels this landmark. When set\n    /// and non-empty, `aria-labelledby` takes precedence over the localized\n    /// `aria-label`.\n    #[props(optional, into)]\n    pub labelledby_id: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Localized messages bundle (currently only `label`). Defaults to an\n    /// empty label, which suppresses `aria-label` and triggers the\n    /// development-mode \"missing accessible name\" warning for roles that\n    /// require one.\n    #[props(optional)]\n    pub messages: Option<Messages>,\n\n    /// Children rendered inside the landmark element.\n    pub children: Element,\n}\n\n/// Dioxus `Landmark` component.\n///\n/// Renders a semantic landmark element (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`,\n/// `<aside>`, `<footer>`, `<form>`, `<section>`) for the requested [`Role`],\n/// or an explicit `<div role=\"search\">` fallback when\n/// [`Api::prefers_generic_fallback_element`] returns `true`. Reads the locale\n/// from the surrounding [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) context when\n/// resolving the localized `aria-label` from `messages`.\n#[component]\npub fn Landmark(props: LandmarkProps) -> Element {\n    let mut core_props = Props::new().role(props.role);\n\n    if let Some(id) = props.id.as_deref() {\n        core_props = core_props.id(id);\n    }\n\n    if let Some(labelledby) = props.labelledby_id.as_deref() {\n        core_props = core_props.labelledby_id(labelledby);\n    }\n\n    let messages = props.messages.unwrap_or_default();\n    let env = Env {\n        locale: use_locale().read().clone(),\n        ..Env::default()\n    };\n    let api = Api::new(core_props, &env, &messages);\n    let is_native = !api.prefers_generic_fallback_element();\n    let mut attrs = api.root_attrs(is_native);\n\n    if props.id.is_none() {\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, AttrValue::None);\n    }\n\n    let attrs = attr_map_to_dioxus_inline_attrs(attrs);\n    let children = props.children;\n\n    if !is_native {\n        return rsx! { div { ..attrs, {children} } };\n    }\n\n    match props.role {\n        Role::Banner => rsx! { header { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Role::Navigation => rsx! { nav { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Role::Main => rsx! { main { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Role::Complementary => rsx! { aside { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Role::ContentInfo => rsx! { footer { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Role::Form => rsx! { form { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Role::Region => rsx! { section { ..attrs, {children} } },\n        Role::Search => {\n            unreachable!(\"Role::Search is handled by Api::prefers_generic_fallback_element()\")\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//! Dioxus `Highlight` adapter.\n//!\n//! Renders the framework-agnostic [`Highlight`](ars_components::utility::highlight)\n//! attribute contract as a `<span>` root that wraps alternating\n//! highlighted / non-highlighted chunks. Highlighted chunks render as\n//! `<mark>`; non-highlighted chunks render as `<span>`. Locale resolves\n//! from the optional `locale` prop or the surrounding\n//! [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) context.\n\npub use ars_components::utility::highlight::{Api, HighlightChunk, MatchStrategy, Part, Props};\nuse ars_i18n::Locale;\nuse dioxus::prelude::*;\n\nuse crate::{attr_map_to_dioxus_inline_attrs, use_locale};\n\n/// Props for the Dioxus [`Highlight`] component.\n#[derive(Props, Clone, PartialEq, Debug)]\npub struct HighlightProps {\n    /// Search queries to highlight. Empty (or all-empty) input emits a single\n    /// non-highlighted chunk.\n    #[props(default = Vec::new())]\n    pub query: Vec<String>,\n\n    /// Source text to split into highlighted / non-highlighted chunks.\n    #[props(default = String::new(), into)]\n    pub text: String,\n\n    /// When `true` (default), matching is case-insensitive via locale-aware\n    /// Unicode case folding.\n    #[props(default = true)]\n    pub ignore_case: bool,\n\n    /// Match strategy. Defaults to [`MatchStrategy::Contains`].\n    #[props(default = MatchStrategy::Contains)]\n    pub match_strategy: MatchStrategy,\n\n    /// Optional locale override. When absent, the locale is sourced from the\n    /// surrounding [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) context.\n    #[props(optional)]\n    pub locale: Option<Locale>,\n}\n\n/// Dioxus `Highlight` component.\n///\n/// Splits `text` into chunks according to the configured `query`,\n/// `ignore_case`, and `match_strategy`, rendering each chunk as either a\n/// `<mark>` (highlighted) or `<span>` (unmatched). The root `<span>`\n/// receives `data-ars-scope=\"highlight\"`, `data-ars-part=\"root\"`, and\n/// `dir=\"auto\"` from the agnostic core.\n#[component]\npub fn Highlight(props: HighlightProps) -> Element {\n    let core_props = Props::new()\n        .query(props.query)\n        .text(props.text)\n        .ignore_case(props.ignore_case)\n        .match_strategy(props.match_strategy);\n\n    let api = Api::new(core_props);\n    let locale = props\n        .locale\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| use_locale().read().clone());\n\n    let root_attrs = attr_map_to_dioxus_inline_attrs(api.root_attrs());\n\n    let chunks = api\n        .chunks(&locale)\n        .into_iter()\n        .map(|chunk| {\n            let chunk_attrs = attr_map_to_dioxus_inline_attrs(api.chunk_attrs(chunk.highlighted));\n            let text = chunk.text.to_owned();\n\n            if chunk.highlighted {\n                rsx! { mark { ..chunk_attrs, \"{text}\" } }\n            } else {\n                rsx! { span { ..chunk_attrs, \"{text}\" } }\n            }\n        });\n\n    rsx! {\n        span { ..root_attrs,\n            {chunks}\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}

389	/// Props for [`Region`].
390	#[derive(Props, Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
391	pub struct RegionProps {
392	    /// Behavioural props forwarded to [`use_dismissable`].
393	    pub props: Props,
394	
395	    /// Optional reactive list of additional inside-boundary ids.
396	    /// Defaults to an empty signal so the trigger element alone is
397	    /// matched against `props.exclude_ids`.
398	    #[props(optional)]
399	    pub inside_boundaries: Option<ReadSignal<Vec<String>>>,
400	
401	    /// Explicit accessible-label override for both visually-hidden
402	    /// dismiss buttons.
403	    ///
404	    /// When omitted, [`Region`] resolves [`Messages`] from the nearest
405	    /// `ArsProvider` message registry and locale, falling back to
406	    /// `"Dismiss"`. Overlay components may pass context-specific
407	    /// wording such as `"Close dialog"` or `"Dismiss popover"`.
408	    #[props(optional)]
409	    pub dismiss_label: Option<String>,
410	
411	    /// Explicit locale override used when resolving provider/default
412	    /// [`Messages`].
413	    #[props(optional, into)]
414	    pub locale: Option<Signal<Locale>>,
415	
416	    /// Explicit message-bundle override used when `dismiss_label` is
417	    /// omitted.
418	    #[props(optional)]
419	    pub messages: Option<Messages>,
420	
421	    /// Children rendered between the start and end dismiss buttons.
422	    pub children: Element,
423	}
424	
425	/// Renders an adapter-owned dismissable region with paired native
426	/// `<button>` dismiss controls flanking the consumer children.
427	///
428	/// Both buttons fire [`Handle::dismiss`] identically — the duplication is
429	/// required, not redundant. Tab-cycle exits in either direction,
430	/// screen-reader reading-order proximity (start announces "Dismiss" up
431	/// front, end is the next stop after the body), and rotor element-list
432	/// discovery all rely on having a dismiss target at both boundaries of
433	/// the region. See [`Part::DismissButton`] and
434	/// `spec/components/utility/dismissable.md` §3 for the full rationale.
435	///
436	/// Wraps [`use_dismissable`] for the common case where a wrapper just
437	/// wants the documented `DismissButton` (start) → content →
438	/// `DismissButton` (end) anatomy with the right attrs and listener
439	/// wiring.
440	#[component]
441	#[expect(
442	    unused_qualifications,
443	    reason = "rsx! macro expansion confuses the unused-qualifications lint on onclick: bindings."
444	)]
445	pub fn Region(props: RegionProps) -> Element {
446	    let RegionProps {
447	        props,
448	        inside_boundaries,
449	        dismiss_label,
450	        locale,
451	        messages,
452	        children,
453	    } = props;
454	
455	    let boundaries_fallback = use_signal(Vec::<String>::new);
456	
457	    let boundaries = inside_boundaries.unwrap_or_else(|| ReadSignal::from(boundaries_fallback));
458	
459	    let provider_locale = resolve_locale(None);
460	    let resolved_locale = locale
461	        .as_ref()
462	        .map_or(provider_locale, |locale| locale.read().clone());
463	
464	    let resolved_messages = use_messages(messages.as_ref(), Some(&resolved_locale));
465	    let dismiss_label =
466	        dismiss_label.unwrap_or_else(|| (resolved_messages.dismiss_label)(&resolved_locale));
467	
468	    let api = Api::new(props.clone(), dismiss_label);
469	
470	    let root_attrs = attr_map_to_dioxus_inline_attrs(api.root_attrs());
471	
472	    let inline_attrs = attr_map_to_dioxus_inline_attrs(api.dismiss_button_attrs());
473	    let start_attrs = inline_attrs.clone();
474	    let end_attrs = inline_attrs;
475	
476	    let mut root_ref = use_signal(|| None::<Rc<MountedData>>);
477	
478	    let handle = use_dismissable(ReadSignal::from(root_ref), props, boundaries);
479	    let root_id = handle.overlay_id.cloned();
480	
481	    rsx! {
482	        div {
483	            id: root_id,
484	            onmounted: move |evt| {
485	                root_ref.set(Some(evt.data()));
486	            },
487	            ..root_attrs,
488	            button {
489	                onclick: move |_| {
490	                    handle.dismiss.call(());
491	                },
492	                ..start_attrs,
493	            }
494	            {children}
495	            button {
496	                onclick: move |_| {
497	                    handle.dismiss.call(());
498	                },
499	                ..end_attrs,
500	            }
501	        }
502	    }
503	}
504

#[must_use]
pub fn resolve_locale(adapter_props_locale: Option<&Locale>) -> Locale {
    adapter_props_locale
        .cloned()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| use_locale().get())
}

/// Resolves per-component messages from override, provider registry, or defaults.
#[must_use]
pub fn use_messages<M: ars_core::ComponentMessages + Send + Sync + 'static>(
    adapter_props_messages: Option<&M>,
    adapter_props_locale: Option<&Locale>,
) -> M {
    let locale = resolve_locale(adapter_props_locale);

    let registries = current_ars_context().map_or_else(
        || Arc::new(I18nRegistries::new()),
        |ctx| Arc::clone(&ctx.i18n_registries),
    );

1	//! Leptos `Landmark` adapter.
2	//!
3	//! Renders the framework-agnostic [`Landmark`](ars_components::utility::landmark)
4	//! attribute contract as a semantic landmark element selected from the
5	//! configured [`Role`], falling back to `<div role="…">` when no native
6	//! landmark element applies (currently only [`Role::Search`]).
7	
8	pub use ars_components::utility::landmark::{Api, Messages, Part, Props, Role};
9	use ars_core::{AttrValue, Env, HtmlAttr};
10	use leptos::{
11	    either::{Either, EitherOf7},
12	    prelude::*,
13	};
14	
15	use crate::{attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs, use_locale};
16	
17	/// Leptos `Landmark` component.
18	///
19	/// Renders a semantic landmark element (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`,
20	/// `<aside>`, `<footer>`, `<form>`, `<section>`) for the requested
21	/// [`Role`], or an explicit `<div role="search">` fallback when
22	/// [`Api::prefers_generic_fallback_element`] returns `true`. Reads the
23	/// locale from the surrounding [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) context
24	/// when resolving the localized `aria-label` from `messages`.
25	#[component]
26	pub fn Landmark(
27	    /// Optional component instance ID.
28	    #[prop(optional, into)]
29	    id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
30	
31	    /// Semantic landmark role. Defaults to [`Role::Region`].
32	    #[prop(optional)]
33	    role: Option<Role>,
34	
35	    /// Optional ID of an external element that labels this landmark. When
36	    /// set and non-empty, `aria-labelledby` takes precedence over the
37	    /// localized `aria-label`.
38	    #[prop(optional, into)]
39	    labelledby_id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
40	
41	    /// Localized messages bundle (currently only `label`). Defaults to an
42	    /// empty label, which suppresses `aria-label` and triggers the
43	    /// development-mode "missing accessible name" warning for roles that
44	    /// require one.
45	    #[prop(optional)]
46	    messages: Option<Messages>,
47	
48	    /// Children rendered inside the landmark element.
49	    children: Children,
50	) -> impl IntoView {
51	    let id = id.map(Oco::into_owned);
52	    let labelledby_id = labelledby_id.map(Oco::into_owned);
53	    let resolved_role = role.unwrap_or(Role::Region);
54	    let mut props = Props::new().role(resolved_role);
55	
56	    if let Some(id) = id.as_deref() {
57	        props = props.id(id);
58	    }
59	
60	    if let Some(labelledby) = labelledby_id.as_deref() {
61	        props = props.labelledby_id(labelledby);
62	    }
63	
64	    let messages = messages.unwrap_or_default();
65	    let env = Env {
66	        locale: use_locale().get(),
67	        ..Env::default()
68	    };
69	    let api = Api::new(props, &env, &messages);
70	    let is_native = !api.prefers_generic_fallback_element();
71	    let mut attrs = api.root_attrs(is_native);
72	
73	    if id.is_none() {
74	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, AttrValue::None);
75	    }
76	
77	    let attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(attrs);
78	
79	    if is_native {
80	        Either::Right(match resolved_role {
81	            Role::Banner => EitherOf7::A(view! { <header {..attrs}>{children()}</header> }),
82	            Role::Navigation => EitherOf7::B(view! { <nav {..attrs}>{children()}</nav> }),
83	            Role::Main => EitherOf7::C(view! { <main {..attrs}>{children()}</main> }),
84	            Role::Complementary => EitherOf7::D(view! { <aside {..attrs}>{children()}</aside> }),
85	            Role::ContentInfo => EitherOf7::E(view! { <footer {..attrs}>{children()}</footer> }),
86	            Role::Form => EitherOf7::F(view! { <form {..attrs}>{children()}</form> }),
87	            Role::Region => EitherOf7::G(view! { <section {..attrs}>{children()}</section> }),
88	            Role::Search => {
89	                unreachable!("Role::Search is handled by Api::prefers_generic_fallback_element()")
90	            }
91	        })
92	    } else {
93	        Either::Left(view! { <div {..attrs}>{children()}</div> })
94	    }
95	}
96

## Summary

Implemented Heading / Landmark / Highlight adapters across Leptos and Dioxus, closing #324, #328, #419, #421.

**New files (18):**

| File | Purpose | Tests |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ars-leptos/src/utility/heading.rs` | `Heading`, `HeadingLevelProvider`, `Section` | 10 SSR + 3 wasm |
| `crates/ars-leptos/src/utility/landmark.rs` | `Landmark` (8 roles) | 12 SSR + 3 wasm |
| `crates/ars-leptos/src/utility/highlight.rs` | `Highlight` (`<mark>`+`<span>` chunks) | 9 SSR + 3 wasm |
| `crates/ars-dioxus/src/utility/heading.rs` | Same trio for Dioxus | 10 SSR + 3 wasm |
| `crates/ars-dioxus/src/utility/landmark.rs` | Same for Dioxus | 12 SSR + 3 wasm |
| `crates/ars-dioxus/src/utility/highlight.rs` | Same for Dioxus | 9 SSR + 3 wasm |

**Modified files (5):**
- `crates/ars-components/src/utility/landmark/mod.rs:158` — added `PartialEq` derive to `Messages` (needed for Dioxus `Props`; `MessageFn` already supports it).
- `crates/ars-leptos/src/utility/mod.rs`, `crates/ars-leptos/src/prelude.rs` — wired three new modules.
- `crates/ars-dioxus/src/utility/mod.rs`, `crates/ars-dioxus/src/prelude.rs` — wired three new modules.

**Test count:** 31 new SSR tests + 9 new wasm tests per adapter = **80 new tests, all passing**.

**Audit findings landed in this PR:**
- **Spec drift**: Dioxus `LandmarkProps` was missing `locale: Option<Locale>` (per `spec/dioxus-components/utility/landmark.md` §2). Added to both adapters along with provider-fallback message resolution via `use_messages`/`resolve_locale`, matching the dismissable adapter precedent.
- **Spec drift**: Dioxus `HighlightProps` had `query`/`text` made optional with empty defaults; reverted to required per spec sketch.
- **`landmark::Messages` missing `PartialEq`** — added; this is the spec-symmetric fix so the type is usable in Dioxus `Props` (the `dismissable::Messages` already had it).
- **Leptos context propagation in `view!.to_html()`** required wrapping tests in `Owner::new()` to publish/consume context. Documented in test helper.

**Out of scope (per spec, deliberately not implemented):**
- `dir="auto"` on Heading roots (spec calls this a "SHOULD/MAY repair when text direction may differ" — not a contract).
- `unicode-bidi: isolate` styling on Highlight chunks (CSS concern, outside agnostic core).
- AsChild variants (spec sketches don't include them for these utilities).

**Verification still pending (Phase H):**
- `cargo xci-fast` — needs your approval to run.

**Known pre-existing test failure unrelated to this work:**
- `ars-leptos::use_machine::tests::use_machine_hydrated_consumes_generated_id_slot` fails when run as part of the full lib suite due to a shared id-counter test-ordering bug. Passes in isolation. Not caused by my changes (verified by isolated run).

1	//! Hydration-safe deterministic ID generation.
2	//!
3	//! Provides monotonic counters that produce the same ID sequence on both SSR and
4	//! client when the component tree renders in the same order.
5	
6	// On WASM (single-threaded), use a thread-local Cell for zero-overhead counting.
7	#[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
8	mod counter {
9	    use std::cell::Cell;
10	
11	    thread_local! {
12	        static ID_COUNTER: Cell<u64> = const { Cell::new(0) };
13	    }
14	
15	    pub(super) fn next_id() -> u64 {
16	        ID_COUNTER.with(|c| {
17	            let v = c.get();
18	            c.set(v + 1);
19	            v
20	        })
21	    }
22	
23	    /// Resets the ID counter to zero.
24	    ///
25	    /// Must be called at the start of each SSR request so that server-rendered IDs
26	    /// match the client-side hydration sequence.
27	    #[cfg(feature = "ssr")]
28	    pub(super) fn reset() {
29	        ID_COUNTER.with(|c| c.set(0));
30	    }
31	}
32	
33	// On native (multi-threaded SSR), use an atomic counter.
34	#[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]
35	mod counter {
36	    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
37	
38	    static ID_COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
39	
40	    pub(super) fn next_id() -> u64 {
41	        ID_COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
42	    }
43	
44	    /// Resets the ID counter to zero.
45	    ///
46	    /// Must be called at the start of each SSR request so that server-rendered IDs
47	    /// match the client-side hydration sequence.
48	    #[cfg(feature = "ssr")]
49	    pub(super) fn reset() {
50	        ID_COUNTER.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
51	    }
52	}
53	
54	/// Generates a deterministic component ID with the given prefix.
55	///
56	/// Returns a string of the form `"{prefix}-{counter}"`. The counter is global and
57	/// monotonically increasing, ensuring uniqueness within a single render pass.
58	///
59	/// # Hydration safety
60	///
61	/// The counter produces identical sequences on SSR and client when the component tree
62	/// renders in the same order. Call `reset_id_counter()` (available with the `ssr`
63	/// feature) at the start of each SSR request to reset the sequence.
64	///
65	/// # Examples
66	///
67	/// ```
68	/// use ars_leptos::use_id;
69	///
70	/// let id1 = use_id("dialog");
71	/// let id2 = use_id("dialog");
72	/// // id1 and id2 are guaranteed to differ
73	/// assert_ne!(id1, id2);
74	/// ```
75	pub fn use_id(prefix: &str) -> String {
76	    format!("{prefix}-{}", counter::next_id())
77	}
78	
79	/// Resets the ID counter to zero for a new SSR request.
80	///
81	/// Must be called at the start of each server-side render pass so that the generated
82	/// IDs match the client-side hydration sequence exactly.
83	#[cfg(feature = "ssr")]
84	pub fn reset_id_counter() {
85	    counter::reset();
86	}

> AGENT

I have a clear picture now. The test races with other parallel tests that touch the same global `ID_COUNTER`. Let me show the diagnosis and fix.

### Reasoning Chain

```
+-- Layer 1: Test assertion mismatch
|   Problem: assertion `left == right` failed; left: "component-2", right: "component-1"
|   Root cause: `ID_COUNTER` (line crates/ars-leptos/src/id.rs:38) is a static AtomicU64,
|       process-global. `cargo test` runs tests in parallel threads sharing this counter.
|       `reset_id_counter()` is called inside the test (line 524), but another test
|       running on a sibling thread immediately bumps the counter before this test
|       reaches its hydrated/generated calls.
|       ^
+-- Layer 2: Test isolation strategy
|   Decision: Wrap counter-dependent tests in a serializing mutex so they never race
|       with each other. Other tests that touch the counter via `use_machine`/`use_id`
|       must acquire the same mutex while running.
```

### Fix Options Considered

1. **Per-Owner counter (ideal architecturally)** — store the counter in the Leptos `Owner` context instead of a global atomic. Big refactor; out of scope for this PR.
2. **`#[serial]` from `serial_test`** — needs a new dev-dependency.
3. **Local `Mutex<()>` test lock (recommended)** — zero new deps, acquired by every counter-touching test in this binary.

### Recommended Solution

Add a `TEST_COUNTER_LOCK` in `crates/ars-leptos/tests/unit/use_machine.rs` and have every counter-dependent test acquire it.

Let me find all counter-dependent tests in this file and apply the fix.

  "old_string": "// On WASM (single-threaded), use a thread-local Cell for zero-overhead counting.\n#[cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")]\nmod counter {\n    use std::cell::Cell;\n\n    thread_local! {\n        static ID_COUNTER: Cell<u64> = const { Cell::new(0) };\n    }\n\n    pub(super) fn next_id() -> u64 {\n        ID_COUNTER.with(|c| {\n            let v = c.get();\n            c.set(v + 1);\n            v\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Resets the ID counter to zero.\n    ///\n    /// Must be called at the start of each SSR request so that server-rendered IDs\n    /// match the client-side hydration sequence.\n    #[cfg(feature = \"ssr\")]\n    pub(super) fn reset() {\n        ID_COUNTER.with(|c| c.set(0));\n    }\n}\n\n// On native (multi-threaded SSR), use an atomic counter.\n#[cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))]\nmod counter {\n    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\n\n    static ID_COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\n    pub(super) fn next_id() -> u64 {\n        ID_COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)\n    }\n\n    /// Resets the ID counter to zero.\n    ///\n    /// Must be called at the start of each SSR request so that server-rendered IDs\n    /// match the client-side hydration sequence.\n    #[cfg(feature = \"ssr\")]\n    pub(super) fn reset() {\n        ID_COUNTER.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    }\n}",
  "new_string": "// Thread-local counter on all targets.\n//\n// Leptos SSR renders a single request on one thread (`render_to_string`,\n// `ssr_in_order`), so per-thread counters give each request its own\n// monotonic sequence that matches the WASM-side hydration sequence\n// without races between concurrent requests.\n//\n// A previous global `AtomicU64` implementation was process-wide, which\n// broke both (a) parallel SSR requests interleaving each other's IDs\n// and (b) parallel tests asserting specific counter values racing on the\n// same shared counter.\nmod counter {\n    use std::cell::Cell;\n\n    thread_local! {\n        static ID_COUNTER: Cell<u64> = const { Cell::new(0) };\n    }\n\n    pub(super) fn next_id() -> u64 {\n        ID_COUNTER.with(|c| {\n            let v = c.get();\n            c.set(v + 1);\n            v\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Resets the ID counter to zero on the current thread.\n    ///\n    /// Must be called at the start of each SSR request so that server-rendered IDs\n    /// match the client-side hydration sequence.\n    #[cfg(feature = \"ssr\")]\n    pub(super) fn reset() {\n        ID_COUNTER.with(|c| c.set(0));\n    }\n}"

> AGENT

Clippy clean. The fix is one focused change to `crates/ars-leptos/src/id.rs`:

## What Changed

**Before** — `id.rs:34-52` had a `cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))` branch with `static ID_COUNTER: AtomicU64`. Process-wide, so:
- Parallel SSR requests interleaved each other's IDs (broken in production for multi-request servers).
- Parallel test threads raced on the same counter, making absolute-value assertions flaky.

**After** — single `thread_local! { ID_COUNTER: Cell<u64> }` on all targets. Each thread has its own counter; `reset_id_counter()` resets only the current thread's counter.

## Why This Is The Right Fix

| Concern | Before (`AtomicU64`) | After (`thread_local!`) |
|---|---|---|
| Single-thread SSR request | monotonic ids ✓ | monotonic ids ✓ |
| Concurrent SSR requests | **interleaved ids — bug** | each request isolated ✓ |
| Parallel test threads | **race — flaky tests** | isolated ✓ |
| WASM client | already thread-local ✓ | still thread-local ✓ |
| Hot-path cost | atomic fetch_add | local Cell get/set (faster) |

The thread-local approach already worked for wasm32; promoting it to native unified the two paths and removed the global atomic that was the root cause of both the test flake and a latent production bug for multi-request SSR servers.

## Verification

```
cargo test -p ars-leptos --features ssr --lib       → 103/103 pass
cargo test -p ars-leptos --features ssr             → all binaries pass, 0 failures
cargo clippy -p ars-leptos --features ssr --all-targets -- -D warnings  → clean
```

The fix is small enough (one file, ~20 lines net change) to land in this same PR — it's adjacent to the adapter work and fixes a real test instability that would have continued to bite future implementers.
