  "content": "//! Regression tests for the `#[props(extends = GlobalAttributes)]` pass-through\n//! on every Dioxus adapter component that owns its rendered root.\n//!\n//! These tests confirm that consumer-supplied `class`, `style`, `data-*`,\n//! `aria-*` etc. flow onto the component root and that tokenized values\n//! (`class`, `style`) concatenate with the component's own tokens rather than\n//! clobbering them.\n\n#![cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))]\n\nuse ars_dioxus::utility::{\n    heading::{Heading, Level},\n    highlight::Highlight,\n    landmark::{Landmark, Role},\n    separator::Separator,\n    visually_hidden::VisuallyHidden,\n};\nuse dioxus::prelude::*;\n\nfn render_app(app: fn() -> Element) -> String {\n    let mut vdom = VirtualDom::new(app);\n    vdom.rebuild_in_place();\n    dioxus_ssr::render(&vdom)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn heading_forwards_class_and_data_attrs_to_root() {\n    fn app() -> Element {\n        rsx! {\n            Heading {\n                id: \"h\",\n                level: Level::Two,\n                class: \"text-4xl font-bold\",\n                \"data-testid\": \"title\",\n                \"Title\"\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let html = render_app(app);\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<h2\"), \"expected h2: {html}\");\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"class=\"text-4xl font-bold\"\"#),\n        \"expected class on h2: {html}\"\n    );\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"data-testid=\"title\"\"#),\n        \"expected data-testid on h2: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_forwards_class_to_native_role_root() {\n    fn app() -> Element {\n        rsx! {\n            Landmark {\n                id: \"n\",\n                role: Role::Navigation,\n                class: \"sidebar-nav\",\n                \"links\"\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let html = render_app(app);\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<nav\"));\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"class=\"sidebar-nav\"\"#),\n        \"expected class on nav root: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_forwards_class_to_search_fallback_div() {\n    fn app() -> Element {\n        rsx! {\n            Landmark {\n                id: \"s\",\n                role: Role::Search,\n                class: \"site-search\",\n                \"input\"\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let html = render_app(app);\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<div\"));\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"class=\"site-search\"\"#),\n        \"expected class on search fallback div: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn highlight_forwards_class_to_root_span() {\n    fn app() -> Element {\n        rsx! {\n            Highlight {\n                query: vec![\"x\".to_string()],\n                text: \"hello\",\n                class: \"hl-root\",\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let html = render_app(app);\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<span\"));\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"class=\"hl-root\"\"#),\n        \"expected class on highlight root span: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn separator_forwards_class_to_hr_root() {\n    fn app() -> Element {\n        rsx! {\n            Separator { id: \"sep\", class: \"menu-divider\" }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let html = render_app(app);\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<hr\"));\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"class=\"menu-divider\"\"#),\n        \"expected class on hr root: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn visually_hidden_merges_consumer_class_with_component_class() {\n    // VisuallyHidden's `<span>` already carries the `ars-visually-hidden`\n    // class. Consumer class tokens must concatenate, not clobber.\n    fn app() -> Element {\n        rsx! {\n            VisuallyHidden { id: \"v\", class: \"skip-link\", \"Hidden\" }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let html = render_app(app);\n\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(\"skip-link\"),\n        \"expected consumer class present: {html}\"\n    );\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(\"ars-visually-hidden\"),\n        \"expected component class still present: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn heading_data_ars_scope_wins_over_consumer_override() {\n    // Ordinary (non-token) attributes prefer the component's value on\n    // conflict — the component-managed `data-ars-scope` must not be\n    // overridable by a consumer-supplied attribute.\n    fn app() -> Element {\n        rsx! {\n            Heading { level: Level::Two, \"data-ars-scope\": \"consumer-tried\", \"Title\" }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let html = render_app(app);\n\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"data-ars-scope=\"heading\"\"#),\n        \"component-managed data-ars-scope must survive: {html}\"\n    );\n    assert!(\n        !html.contains(r#\"data-ars-scope=\"consumer-tried\"\"#),\n        \"consumer override must NOT win on component-managed attrs: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n"
}

Why you used `use_memo` in some components new attrs but not in others? Shouldn't we need `use_memo` in all of them?

> AGENT

Good question — let me explain the reasoning. The answer is "no, we don't strictly need `use_memo` everywhere," and the variance reflects each component's existing reactive structure.

## The audit

| Component | Memoized? | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `Heading`, `Landmark`, `Highlight`, `Separator`, `VisuallyHidden` | ❌ direct | **Stateless** — no `use_machine`, no reactive deps in the attr path |
| `Button` | ✅ inside `machine.derive(...)` | **Stateful** — the merge runs *inside* the existing memo |
| `Dismissable::Region` | ❌ direct | The `Api::new(...)` is constructed once per render, no memo on the attr path |
| `Tabs` | ✅ new `use_memo(...)` | The base `tabs_root_attrs(machine)` returns a Memo; I wrapped the merge in another Memo to compose |

## Why we don't need `use_memo` everywhere

A `use_memo` is worthwhile when **all** of these hold:

1. The component body re-runs frequently (reactive signals change often).
2. The base value comes from a Memo (so identity checks downstream can skip work).
3. The merge work is significant enough that re-running it dominates the Memo's bookkeeping overhead.

For the stateless five — Heading, Landmark, Highlight, Separator, VisuallyHidden — none of these conditions hold:

- **(1) is false:** None of these components subscribe to any signal. Their body only re-runs when the parent re-renders, which means **props themselves changed**, which means we *want* a fresh attr computation anyway.
- **(2) is false:** The base attrs are built from `Props::new().…builder…` followed by `attr_map_to_dioxus_inline_attrs(...)` — both pure functions called inline, no Memo.
- **(3) is false:** The merge is `Vec<Attribute>` concatenation with token-list rules. Tiny vecs (< 10 attrs typically). Microseconds.

Adding `use_memo` here would actually *cost* more than it saves — every Memo adds subscription bookkeeping and an equality check on output. For "ran once, returned a small Vec" computations, the bookkeeping is heavier than the merge.

## Why Button uses it (inside `derive`)

Button's existing code:

```rust
let root_attrs = machine.derive(move |api| dioxus_root_attrs(api, &id, &user_attrs, false));
```

The `machine.derive(...)` IS a Memo — it's required so the rendered `<button>` attrs update reactively when the state machine transitions (pressed, loading, disabled, focus, …). I put the consumer attr merge **inside** that same closure so it's part of the existing memoized step — no new Memo needed.

## Why Tabs uses `use_memo`

Tabs's existing pattern:

```rust
let root_attrs = tabs_root_attrs(machine);  // returns a Memo<Vec<Attribute>>
```

`tabs_root_attrs` is already a Memo, called downstream as `root_attrs()`. To compose it with consumer attrs while preserving the "skip if base didn't change" property, the cleanest move is another Memo:

```rust
let root_attrs = use_memo(move || merge_dioxus_attrs(consumer_attrs.clone(), root_attrs()));
```

This isn't strictly required — I could call the merge inline at the rsx splat point — but Tabs's body re-runs on many signal changes (drag state, modality, focus, indicator position, …), so wrapping the merge avoids redoing it on every body re-run.

## Where Dismissable could go either way

Dismissable's `Api::new(props.clone(), dismiss_label)` is built directly in the body (no `use_machine`), so it's structurally like the stateless five. Direct merge is fine. The Region does have reactive bits elsewhere (the dismiss handle, the `root_ref` signal) but the *attr* path doesn't touch them.

## The honest take on consistency

You're right that strict consistency has appeal. We have two reasonable uniform choices:

- **All-or-nothing memoization:** force a `use_memo` everywhere. Cost: ~5 stateless components pay micro-overhead they don't need.
- **Inline everywhere:** drop the Tabs `use_memo`, do the merge in the rsx splat. Cost: Tabs merges on every body re-run (cheap, but not zero).

I chose the middle ground because it matches the **pre-existing pattern in the codebase**: separator/visually_hidden are inline (stateless), button uses `machine.derive` (stateful), tabs uses memos throughout (stateful + multi-part). My changes followed each component's local convention rather than imposing a single rule.

If you want me to flip to one uniform style, the cleanest is **"inline everywhere except where there's already a `derive`"** — that drops the Tabs `use_memo` (one fewer Memo allocation, trivial perf change). The other direction (memoize everywhere) means adding ~5 new Memos for code that doesn't benefit.

> DEVELOPER

Currently we have all our fixtures for all component categories living in the same `main.rs` for each adapter crate. I want it broken down in a module per category, this way we can have parallel agents implementing adapter level components at same time without conflicts, as long as they're of different categories

> AGENT

Got it. Let me sketch the proposed structure, then execute after we confirm xci-fast is clean.

**Proposed layout (Leptos and Dioxus mirror each other):**

```
crates/ars-e2e/fixtures/leptos/src/
├── main.rs                  // App, CategoryTab enum, top-level mount + Tabs wiring
└── categories/
    ├── mod.rs               // re-exports + shared i18n_registries() that delegates per-category
    ├── navigation.rs        // NavigationTab + NavigationText + NavigationPanel + tabs::Messages registration
    └── utility.rs           // UtilityText + UtilityPanel + heading/landmark/highlight/dismissable helpers + dismissable::Messages registration
```

**Key boundaries:**

- Each category module owns its `…Text` enum (extracted out of the monolithic `FixtureText`), its panel component, and any per-component helpers (`ZIndexProbe`, `HeadingProviderDemo`, `FixtureError`, …).
- Each category exposes a `register_messages(&mut I18nRegistries)` function. `categories::mod` aggregates them into a single `i18n_registries() -> Arc<I18nRegistries>`.
- `main.rs` only knows the category tab list and mounts the `App`.

**Parallelism property:** an agent working on a new layout-category component edits only `categories/layout.rs` (plus the one-line tab registration in `main.rs`). Two agents on different categories never touch the same file.

Let me check on the in-flight xci-fast first, then start the refactor.

The aggregator\n//! [`i18n_registries`] composes the per-category registrations into the\n//! single `I18nRegistries` that the fixture's `ArsProvider` consumes.\n//!\n//! Add a new category by:\n//!\n//! 1. Creating `categories/<category>.rs` with its own `…Text` enum, panel\n//!    component, and `pub(crate) fn register_messages(&mut I18nRegistries)`\n//!    function.\n//! 2. Declaring `pub mod <category>;` and calling its `register_messages` in\n//!    this file.\n//! 3. Adding the matching variant to `CategoryTab` and the `Tabs` row in\n//!    `main.rs`.\n//!\n//! Parallel agents implementing different categories edit different files\n//! and never collide on the same component module.\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse ars_leptos::I18nRegistries;\n\npub mod navigation;\npub mod utility;\n\n/// Builds the per-fixture [`I18nRegistries`] by delegating to each category\n/// module's `register_messages` hook.\n#[must_use]\npub fn i18n_registries() -> Arc<I18nRegistries> {\n    let mut registries = I18nRegistries::new();\n\n    navigation::register_messages(&mut registries);\n    utility::register_messages(&mut registries);\n\n    Arc::new(registries)\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//! Leptos E2E fixture entry point.\n//!\n//! Each component category lives in its own module under [`categories`]\n//! (e.g. `categories::utility`, `categories::navigation`). Add a new\n//! category by creating `categories/<name>.rs`, declaring `pub mod <name>;`\n//! in `categories/mod.rs`, calling its `register_messages` from\n//! `i18n_registries`, and adding a [`CategoryTab`] variant + [`Tab::new`]\n//! row to the top-level `<Tabs>` below.\n\nmod categories;\n\nuse ars_leptos::{\n    ArsProvider,\n    navigation::tabs::{Tab, Tabs},\n    prelude::{Locale, TabKey, Translate},\n};\nuse leptos::{mount::mount_to_body, prelude::*};\n\nuse crate::categories::{i18n_registries, navigation::NavigationPanel, utility::UtilityPanel};\n\nfn main() {\n    mount_to_body(App);\n}\n\n/// Top-level fixture tabs — one variant per component category.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, TabKey, Translate)]\n#[tab_key(ordinal)]\n#[translate(fallback = \"en-US\")]\nenum CategoryTab {\n    #[translate(en_US = \"Navigation\", pt_BR = \"Navegação\")]\n    Navigation,\n\n    #[translate(en_US = \"Utility\", pt_BR = \"Utilitários\")]\n    Utility,\n}\n\n#[component]\nfn App() -> impl IntoView {\n    let locale = RwSignal::new(Locale::parse(\"en-US\").expect(\"valid fixture locale\"));\n\n    view! {\n        <ArsProvider locale=locale i18n_registries=i18n_registries()>\n            <main class=\"e2e-shell\">\n                <h1>\"ars-ui Leptos E2E fixture\"</h1>\n                <Tabs\n                    default_value=CategoryTab::Utility\n                    tabs=[\n                        Tab::new(CategoryTab::Navigation, NavigationPanel),\n                        Tab::new(CategoryTab::Utility, UtilityPanel),\n                    ]\n                />\n            </main>\n        </ArsProvider>\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//! Per-category fixture modules.\n//!\n//! Each category submodule owns its own `…Text` enum, panel component,\n//! per-component helpers, and message-registry registration. The aggregator\n//! [`i18n_registries`] composes the per-category registrations into the\n//! single `I18nRegistries` that the fixture's `ArsProvider` consumes.\n//!\n//! Add a new category by:\n//!\n//! 1. Creating `categories/<category>.rs` with its own `…Text` enum, panel\n//!    component, and `pub(crate) fn register_messages(&mut I18nRegistries)`\n//!    function.\n//! 2. Declaring `pub mod <category>;` and calling its `register_messages` in\n//!    this file.\n//! 3. Adding the matching variant to `CategoryTab` and the `Tabs` row in\n//!    `main.rs`.\n//!\n//! Parallel agents implementing different categories edit different files\n//! and never collide on the same component module.\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse ars_dioxus::I18nRegistries;\n\npub mod navigation;\npub mod utility;\n\n/// Builds the per-fixture [`I18nRegistries`] by delegating to each category\n/// module's `register_messages` hook.\n#[must_use]\npub fn i18n_registries() -> Arc<I18nRegistries> {\n    let mut registries = I18nRegistries::new();\n\n    navigation::register_messages(&mut registries);\n    utility::register_messages(&mut registries);\n\n    Arc::new(registries)\n}\n"
}

## Summary — fixture restructure

**Before:** Single ~560-line `main.rs` per adapter holding everything (App, panels, FixtureText enum, helpers, i18n_registries).

**After (per adapter):**

```
crates/ars-e2e/fixtures/<adapter>/src/
├── main.rs              (~55 lines)  — App, CategoryTab enum, mount
└── categories/
    ├── mod.rs           (~40 lines)  — aggregator: i18n_registries() that delegates
    ├── navigation.rs    (~115 lines) — NavigationTab, NavigationText, NavigationPanel, tabs::Messages registration
    └── utility.rs       (~415 lines) — UtilityText, UtilityPanel, ZIndexProbe, HeadingProviderDemo, FixtureError(Child), dismissable::Messages registration
```

**The conflict-free property is now structural:**

- An agent implementing a new `input::Checkbox` adapter component edits **only** `categories/input.rs` (after creating it).
- An agent implementing a new `overlay::Dialog` adapter component edits **only** `categories/overlay.rs`.
- They never touch each other's files. `main.rs` and `categories/mod.rs` only change when a **category** is added (one new variant in `CategoryTab`, one `pub mod` line, one `register_messages` call) — and adding-a-category is itself rare.

**Adding a new category template** (one-off, ~3 small edits):
1. Create `categories/<name>.rs` with its own `…Text` enum, `register_messages(&mut I18nRegistries)`, and `<Name>Panel` component.
2. Add `pub mod <name>;` + a `<name>::register_messages(&mut registries);` line to `categories/mod.rs`.
3. Add a `CategoryTab::<Name>` variant + `Tab::new(CategoryTab::<Name>, <name>::<Name>Panel)` row to `main.rs`.

**Validation (no push, no commit):**

> AGENT

Empirical result is concerning. Here's the actual Leptos output for `<VisuallyHidden attr:class="skip-link">`:

```html
<span data-ars-part="root" data-ars-scope="visually-hidden"
      class="ars-visually-hidden" id="probe"
      class="skip-link">Hidden</span>
                            ↑
                            TWO class attributes!
```

So the honest answer is **no, Leptos's `attr:class` does NOT merge with a component-supplied class** — it emits a second `class=` attribute, producing duplicate-attribute HTML. Per HTML5 spec browsers typically take the **first** attribute, so the consumer's `skip-link` gets silently dropped in practice.

## What works vs what doesn't on the Leptos side

| Leptos component | Internal class? | `attr:class` behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `Heading` | none | ✅ works — user class is the only one |
| `Landmark` | none | ✅ works |
| `Highlight` | none | ✅ works |
| `Separator` | none | ✅ works |
| `VisuallyHidden` (non-focusable) | emits `ars-visually-hidden` | ❌ duplicate `class=`, consumer ignored |
| `Button` (any state) | emits multiple internal classes via the machine | ❌ same problem |
| `Tabs` and its parts | varies | ❌ same problem on parts with classes |

The Dioxus side does **not** have this problem — `merge_dioxus_attrs` tokenizes-merges class/style and produces a single merged attribute.

## Why this is a real correctness gap

My earlier claim that "Leptos `attr:class` works for free" was correct only for the four components that don't emit any class themselves. For the components that **do** emit a class, the pass-through is silently broken: the consumer's Tailwind tokens never reach the rendered element in most browsers.

## Options

1. **Add an explicit `class` prop on every Leptos component that emits a class internally** (VisuallyHidden's non-AsChild path, Button, Tabs root). The component merges it with its own class tokens before passing to the view. This mirrors what Dioxus's `extends = GlobalAttributes` + `merge_dioxus_attrs` does. ~5 components affected, similar surgery to what we did on the Dioxus side.

2. **Use Leptos's `class:foo=true` boolean-token syntax** — adds individual class tokens without overwriting. But this requires the consumer to know each token name in advance; doesn't work for arbitrary class strings like Tailwind utility chains.

3. **Wrap user `attr:class` parsing in adapter code** — split the user string on whitespace, emit each as a `class:foo=true` via `add_any_attr`. Doable but bespoke.

4. **Document the limitation** — say "use `attr:class` on Heading/Landmark/Highlight/Separator only; for VisuallyHidden/Button/Tabs use the dedicated `class` prop (which we'd need to add)." Worst option — silent breakage.

My recommendation: **option 1** for symmetry with the Dioxus side. We'd:
- Add an explicit `#[prop(optional, into)] class: Option<Oco<'static, str>>` (and same for `style`) on `VisuallyHidden`, `Button`, `Tabs`, and similar.
- The component merges with its internal class tokens before rendering.
- We leave `attr:*` for everything else (data-*, aria-*, lang, etc.) where there's no conflict.

This is more work than I expected when I gave you the "Leptos handles it for free" answer earlier — that was wrong for class-emitting components specifically. Sorry about that.

fn attr_value_to_leptos_attr(name: String, value: AttrValue) -> Option<LeptosAttribute> {
    use leptos::tachys::html::attribute::any_attribute::IntoAnyAttribute as _;

    match value {
        AttrValue::String(text) => {
            Some(leptos::attr::custom::custom_attribute(name, text).into_any_attr())
        }

        AttrValue::Bool(true) => Some(string_attr(name, String::new())),

        AttrValue::Reactive(f) => {
            // tachys's `AttributeValue for F where F: ReactiveFunction`
            // wraps the closure in a `RenderEffect`, so the rendered
            // attribute updates whenever the signals read inside the
            // closure change.
            let closure = move || f();

            Some(leptos::attr::custom::custom_attribute(name, closure).into_any_attr())
        }

fn apply_user_root_attrs(attrs: &mut AttrMap, user_attrs: &UserRootAttrs) {
    if let Some(class) = &user_attrs.class {
        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Class, class.as_str());
    }

    if let Some(label) = &user_attrs.aria_label {
        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), label.as_str());
    }

    if let Some(labelledby) = &user_attrs.aria_labelledby {
        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::LabelledBy), labelledby.as_str());
    }
}

fn strip_dynamic_root_attrs(attrs: &mut AttrMap) {
    for attr in [
        HtmlAttr::Data("ars-state"),
        HtmlAttr::Data("ars-loading"),
        HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"),
        HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"),
        HtmlAttr::Data("ars-pressed"),
        HtmlAttr::Disabled,
        HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Busy),
        HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled),
    ] {
        attrs.set(attr, AttrValue::None);
    }
}

fn add_dynamic_root_attrs(attrs: &mut AttrMap, machine: crate::UseMachineReturn<button::Machine>) {
    let state = root_attr_string_memo(machine, HtmlAttr::Data("ars-state"));
    let loading = root_attr_bool_memo(machine, HtmlAttr::Data("ars-loading"));
    let disabled = root_attr_bool_memo(machine, HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"));
    let focus_visible = root_attr_bool_memo(machine, HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"));
    let pressed = root_attr_bool_memo(machine, HtmlAttr::Data("ars-pressed"));
    let html_disabled = root_attr_bool_memo(machine, HtmlAttr::Disabled);

  "new_string": "/// Converts an [`AttrMap`] into Leptos attributes using the configured\n/// [`StyleStrategy`] from the surrounding [`ArsProvider`].\n///\n/// Defaults to [`StyleStrategy::Inline`] when no provider is in scope.\n/// Use this when the component does not need to apply styles via CSSOM\n/// to the DOM or inject `nonce_css` into a `<style>` block.\n#[must_use]\npub fn attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(map: AttrMap) -> Vec<LeptosAttribute> {\n    attr_map_to_leptos(map, &StyleStrategy::Inline, None).attrs\n}\n\n/// Pre-merges a consumer-supplied `class` token string with whatever class\n/// the component has already written into `map`.\n///\n/// Used by adapter components that expose an explicit `class` prop to let\n/// Tailwind / CSS-utility consumers add their own tokens onto the rendered\n/// root. The merge happens in the [`AttrMap`] layer so the final\n/// conversion emits a *single* `class=\"…\"` attribute — Leptos's\n/// `attr:class=\"…\"` pass-through emits a second `class=` attribute when an\n/// internal class is already present, which browsers drop per HTML5\n/// duplicate-attribute rules.\n///\n/// Behavior:\n/// - If both component and consumer classes are present and non-empty, the\n///   merged value is `\"{component} {consumer}\"` (consumer tokens win on\n///   CSS-specificity ties because they appear later).\n/// - If only one side is non-empty, that side is kept.\n/// - Empty / whitespace-only consumer strings are ignored.\npub fn merge_consumer_class_into(map: &mut AttrMap, consumer_class: Option<&str>) {\n    let Some(consumer) = consumer_class.map(str::trim).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) else {\n        return;\n    };\n\n    let merged = map\n        .get(&ars_core::HtmlAttr::Class)\n        .filter(|existing| !existing.trim().is_empty())\n        .map_or_else(\n            || consumer.to_owned(),\n            |existing| format!(\"{existing} {consumer}\"),\n        );\n\n    map.set(ars_core::HtmlAttr::Class, merged);\n}"
}

1	//! Leptos `Heading` adapter.
2	//!
3	//! Renders the framework-agnostic [`Heading`](ars_components::utility::heading)
4	//! attribute contract as a semantic `<h1>`–`<h6>` element whose level resolves
5	//! from explicit props or the inherited [`HeadingContext`]. Ships alongside
6	//! [`HeadingLevelProvider`] and [`Section`] provider components so descendants
7	//! receive an updated `HeadingContext` without prop drilling.
8	
9	pub use ars_components::utility::heading::{
10	    Api, HeadingContext, Level, Part, Props, heading_level_provider, section,
11	};
12	use ars_core::{AttrValue, HtmlAttr};
13	use leptos::{either::EitherOf6, prelude::*};
14	
15	use crate::attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs;
16	
17	/// Reads the inherited heading level context, defaulting to [`HeadingContext::new`]
18	/// (level one) when no provider is in scope.
19	fn inherited_context() -> HeadingContext {
20	    use_context::<HeadingContext>().unwrap_or_default()
21	}
22	
23	/// Leptos `Heading` component.
24	///
25	/// Renders a semantic `<h1>`–`<h6>` element whose level is resolved from the
26	/// explicit `level` prop, the nearest [`HeadingContext`] published by
27	/// [`HeadingLevelProvider`] or [`Section`], or [`Level::One`] when no provider
28	/// is in scope.
29	#[component]
30	pub fn Heading(
31	    /// Optional component instance ID.
32	    #[prop(optional, into)]
33	    id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
34	
35	    /// Explicit heading level override; when absent, the nearest
36	    /// [`HeadingContext`] supplies the resolved level.
37	    #[prop(optional)]
38	    level: Option<Level>,
39	
40	    /// Heading content rendered inside the resolved tag.
41	    children: Children,
42	) -> impl IntoView {
43	    let id = id.map(Oco::into_owned);
44	
45	    let ctx = inherited_context();
46	
47	    let mut props = Props::new();
48	
49	    if let Some(id) = id.as_deref() {
50	        props = props.id(id);
51	    }
52	
53	    if let Some(level) = level {
54	        props = props.level(level);
55	    }
56	
57	    let api = Api::new(props, ctx);
58	
59	    let resolved = api.resolved_level();
60	
61	    let mut attrs = api.root_attrs(true);
62	
63	    if id.is_none() {
64	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, AttrValue::None);
65	    }
66	
67	    let attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(attrs);
68	
69	    match resolved {
70	        Level::One => EitherOf6::A(view! { <h1 {..attrs}>{children()}</h1> }),
71	        Level::Two => EitherOf6::B(view! { <h2 {..attrs}>{children()}</h2> }),
72	        Level::Three => EitherOf6::C(view! { <h3 {..attrs}>{children()}</h3> }),
73	        Level::Four => EitherOf6::D(view! { <h4 {..attrs}>{children()}</h4> }),
74	        Level::Five => EitherOf6::E(view! { <h5 {..attrs}>{children()}</h5> }),
75	        Level::Six => EitherOf6::F(view! { <h6 {..attrs}>{children()}</h6> }),
76	    }
77	}
78	
79	/// Leptos `HeadingLevelProvider` component.
80	///
81	/// Provider-only component that publishes a starting [`HeadingContext`] to its
82	/// descendants. Renders no DOM of its own.
83	#[component]
84	pub fn HeadingLevelProvider(
85	    /// Starting heading level to publish to descendants.
86	    level: Level,
87	
88	    /// Descendants that should observe the published [`HeadingContext`].
89	    children: Children,
90	) -> impl IntoView {
91	    let provider_props = heading_level_provider::Props::new().level(level);
92	
93	    provide_context(heading_level_provider::context_for(&provider_props));
94	
95	    children()
96	}
97	
98	/// Leptos `Section` component.
99	///
100	/// Provider-only component that publishes an incremented [`HeadingContext`] to
101	/// its descendants, clamped at [`Level::Six`]. Renders no DOM of its own.
102	#[component]
103	pub fn Section(
104	    /// Descendants that should observe the incremented [`HeadingContext`].
105	    children: Children,
106	) -> impl IntoView {
107	    let parent = inherited_context();
108	
109	    provide_context(section::context_for(&parent));
110	
111	    children()
112	}
113

Use this for\n    /// Tailwind utility chains or any other CSS class list — the tokens\n    /// merge with whatever class the component itself emits so both reach\n    /// the rendered `<h*>` as a single `class` attribute.\n    #[prop(optional, into)]\n    class: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,\n\n    /// Heading content rendered inside the resolved tag.\n    children: Children,\n) -> impl IntoView {\n    let id = id.map(Oco::into_owned);\n    let class = class.map(Oco::into_owned);\n\n    let ctx = inherited_context();\n\n    let mut props = Props::new();\n\n    if let Some(id) = id.as_deref() {\n        props = props.id(id);\n    }\n\n    if let Some(level) = level {\n        props = props.level(level);\n    }\n\n    let api = Api::new(props, ctx);\n\n    let resolved = api.resolved_level();\n\n    let mut attrs = api.root_attrs(true);\n\n    if id.is_none() {\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, AttrValue::None);\n    }\n\n    merge_consumer_class_into(&mut attrs, class.as_deref());\n\n    let attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(attrs);"

55	    /// surrounding [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) locale is used.
56	    #[prop(optional)]
57	    locale: Option<Locale>,
58	
59	    /// Children rendered inside the landmark element.
60	    children: Children,
61	) -> impl IntoView {
62	    let id = id.map(Oco::into_owned);
63	    let labelledby_id = labelledby_id.map(Oco::into_owned);
64	    let resolved_role = role.unwrap_or(Role::Region);
65	    let mut props = Props::new().role(resolved_role);
66	
67	    if let Some(id) = id.as_deref() {
68	        props = props.id(id);
69	    }
70	
71	    if let Some(labelledby) = labelledby_id.as_deref() {
72	        props = props.labelledby_id(labelledby);
73	    }
74	
75	    let resolved_locale = resolve_locale(locale.as_ref());
76	    let resolved_messages = use_messages::<Messages>(messages.as_ref(), Some(&resolved_locale));
77	    let env = Env {
78	        locale: resolved_locale,
79	        ..Env::default()
80	    };
81	    let api = Api::new(props, &env, &resolved_messages);
82	    let is_native = !api.prefers_generic_fallback_element();
83	    let mut attrs = api.root_attrs(is_native);
84	
85	    if id.is_none() {
86	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, AttrValue::None);
87	    }
88	
89	    let attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(attrs);
90	
91	    if is_native {
92	        Either::Right(match resolved_role {
93	            Role::Banner => EitherOf7::A(view! { <header {..attrs}>{children()}</header> }),
94	            Role::Navigation => EitherOf7::B(view! { <nav {..attrs}>{children()}</nav> }),
95	            Role::Main => EitherOf7::C(view! { <main {..attrs}>{children()}</main> }),
96	            Role::Complementary => EitherOf7::D(view! { <aside {..attrs}>{children()}</aside> }),
97	            Role::ContentInfo => EitherOf7::E(view! { <footer {..attrs}>{children()}</footer> }),
98	            Role::Form => EitherOf7::F(view! { <form {..attrs}>{children()}</form> }),
99	            Role::Region => EitherOf7::G(view! { <section {..attrs}>{children()}</section> }),
100	            Role::Search => {
101	                unreachable!("Role::Search is handled by Api::prefers_generic_fallback_element()")
102	            }

1	//! Leptos `Highlight` adapter.
2	//!
3	//! Renders the framework-agnostic [`Highlight`](ars_components::utility::highlight)
4	//! attribute contract as a `<span>` root that wraps alternating
5	//! highlighted / non-highlighted chunks. Highlighted chunks render as
6	//! `<mark>`; non-highlighted chunks render as `<span>`. Locale resolves
7	//! from the optional `locale` prop or the surrounding
8	//! [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) context.
9	
10	pub use ars_components::utility::highlight::{Api, HighlightChunk, MatchStrategy, Part, Props};
11	use ars_i18n::Locale;
12	use leptos::{either::Either, prelude::*};
13	
14	use crate::{attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs, use_locale};
15	
16	/// Leptos `Highlight` component.
17	///
18	/// Splits `text` into chunks according to the configured `query`,
19	/// `ignore_case`, and `match_strategy`, rendering each chunk as either a
20	/// `<mark>` (highlighted) or `<span>` (unmatched). The root `<span>`
21	/// receives `data-ars-scope="highlight"`, `data-ars-part="root"`, and
22	/// `dir="auto"` from the agnostic core.
23	#[component]
24	pub fn Highlight(
25	    /// Search queries to highlight. Empty (or all-empty) input emits a
26	    /// single non-highlighted chunk.
27	    #[prop(optional, into)]
28	    query: Vec<String>,
29	
30	    /// Source text to split into highlighted / non-highlighted chunks.
31	    #[prop(optional, into)]
32	    text: String,
33	
34	    /// When `true` (default), matching is case-insensitive via
35	    /// locale-aware Unicode case folding.
36	    #[prop(optional)]
37	    ignore_case: Option<bool>,
38	
39	    /// Match strategy. Defaults to [`MatchStrategy::Contains`].
40	    #[prop(optional)]
41	    match_strategy: Option<MatchStrategy>,
42	
43	    /// Optional locale override. When absent, the locale is sourced from
44	    /// the surrounding [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) context.
45	    #[prop(optional)]
46	    locale: Option<Locale>,
47	) -> impl IntoView {
48	    let props = Props::new()
49	        .query(query)
50	        .text(text)
51	        .ignore_case(ignore_case.unwrap_or(true))
52	        .match_strategy(match_strategy.unwrap_or_default());
53	
54	    let api = Api::new(props);
55	    let locale = locale.unwrap_or_else(|| use_locale().get());
56	
57	    let root_attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(api.root_attrs());
58	
59	    let chunks = api
60	        .chunks(&locale)
61	        .into_iter()
62	        .map(|chunk| {
63	            let chunk_attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(api.chunk_attrs(chunk.highlighted));
64	            let text = chunk.text.to_owned();
65	
66	            if chunk.highlighted {
67	                Either::Left(view! { <mark {..chunk_attrs}>{text}</mark> })
68	            } else {
69	                Either::Right(view! { <span {..chunk_attrs}>{text}</span> })
70	            }
71	        })
72	        .collect_view();
73	
74	    view! { <span {..root_attrs}>{chunks}</span> }
75	}
76

1	//! Leptos Separator adapter.
2	//!
3	//! Renders the framework-agnostic `Separator` root attributes onto either an
4	//! adapter-owned `<hr>` node or a consumer-owned root through
5	//! [`SeparatorAsChild`].
6	
7	pub use ars_components::utility::separator::{Api, Part, Props};
8	use ars_core::HtmlAttr;
9	pub use ars_i18n::Orientation;
10	use leptos::{children::TypedChildren, prelude::*, tachys::view::add_attr::AddAnyAttr};
11	
12	use crate::{as_child::AsChildAttrs, attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs};
13	
14	fn root_attrs(
15	    id: Option<String>,
16	    orientation: Orientation,
17	    decorative: bool,
18	) -> Vec<crate::LeptosAttribute> {
19	    let mut props = Props::new().orientation(orientation).decorative(decorative);
20	
21	    if let Some(id) = id.clone() {
22	        props = props.id(id);
23	    }
24	
25	    let mut attrs = Api::new(props).root_attrs();
26	
27	    if let Some(id) = id {
28	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, id);
29	    }
30	
31	    attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(attrs)
32	}
33	
34	/// Leptos Separator component rendered as a single `<hr>` root.
35	#[component]
36	pub fn Separator(
37	    /// Optional component instance ID.
38	    #[prop(optional, into)]
39	    id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
40	
41	    /// Separator orientation.
42	    #[prop(optional)]
43	    orientation: Orientation,
44	
45	    /// Whether the separator is decorative and hidden from the accessibility tree.
46	    #[prop(optional)]
47	    decorative: bool,
48	) -> impl IntoView {
49	    let id = id.map(Oco::into_owned);
50	    let attrs = root_attrs(id, orientation, decorative);
51	
52	    view! { <hr {..attrs} /> }
53	}
54	
55	/// Leptos Separator component that forwards root attrs to one child root.
56	#[component]
57	pub fn SeparatorAsChild<T>(
58	    /// Optional component instance ID.
59	    #[prop(optional, into)]
60	    id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
61	
62	    /// Separator orientation.
63	    #[prop(optional)]
64	    orientation: Orientation,
65	
66	    /// Whether the separator is decorative and hidden from the accessibility tree.
67	    #[prop(optional)]
68	    decorative: bool,
69	
70	    /// Child root that receives the separator root attrs.
71	    children: TypedChildren<T>,
72	) -> impl IntoView
73	where
74	    View<T>: AddAnyAttr,
75	    <View<T> as AddAnyAttr>::Output<Vec<crate::LeptosAttribute>>: IntoView,
76	{
77	    let id = id.map(Oco::into_owned);
78	
79	    children.into_inner()()
80	        .add_any_attr(AsChildAttrs::from(root_attrs(id, orientation, decorative)).into_inner())
81	}

13	fn root_attr_map(id: Option<String>, is_focusable: bool, as_child: bool) -> AttrMap {
14	    let mut props = Props::new().is_focusable(is_focusable).as_child(as_child);
15	
16	    if let Some(id) = id.clone() {
17	        props = props.id(id);
18	    }
19	
20	    let mut attrs = Api::new(props).root_attrs();
21	
22	    if let Some(id) = id {
23	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, id);
24	    }
25	
26	    attrs
27	}
28	
29	fn root_attrs(
30	    id: Option<String>,
31	    is_focusable: bool,
32	    as_child: bool,
33	) -> Vec<crate::LeptosAttribute> {
34	    attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(root_attr_map(id, is_focusable, as_child))
35	}
36	
37	fn as_child_root_attrs(id: Option<String>, is_focusable: bool) -> Vec<crate::LeptosAttribute> {
38	    use leptos::tachys::html::attribute::any_attribute::IntoAnyAttribute as _;
39	
40	    let mut attrs = root_attr_map(id, is_focusable, true);
41	
42	    if !is_focusable {
43	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Class, AttrValue::None);
44	    }
45	
46	    let mut leptos_attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(attrs);
47	
48	    if !is_focusable {
49	        leptos_attrs.push(
50	            leptos::tachys::html::class::class(("ars-visually-hidden", true)).into_any_attr(),
51	        );
52	    }
53	
54	    leptos_attrs
55	}
56	
57	/// Leptos VisuallyHidden component rendered as an adapter-owned `<span>` root.
58	#[component]
59	pub fn VisuallyHidden<T>(
60	    /// Optional component instance ID.
61	    #[prop(optional, into)]
62	    id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
63	
64	    /// Whether the hidden content should become visible when focused.
65	    #[prop(optional)]
66	    is_focusable: bool,
67	
68	    /// Hidden content that remains available to assistive technology.
69	    children: TypedChildren<T>,
70	) -> impl IntoView
71	where
72	    View<T>: IntoView,
73	{
74	    let id = id.map(Oco::into_owned);
75	    let attrs = root_attrs(id, is_focusable, false);
76	    let children = children.into_inner();
77	
78	    view! { <span {..attrs}>{children()}</span> }
79	}
80	
81	/// Leptos VisuallyHidden component that forwards root attrs to one child root.
82	#[component]
83	pub fn VisuallyHiddenAsChild<T>(
84	    /// Optional component instance ID.
85	    #[prop(optional, into)]
86	    id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
87	
88	    /// Whether the hidden content should become visible when focused.
89	    #[prop(optional)]
90	    is_focusable: bool,
91	
92	    /// Child root that receives the visually-hidden root attrs.
93	    children: TypedChildren<T>,
94	) -> impl IntoView
95	where
96	    View<T>: AddAnyAttr,
97	    <View<T> as AddAnyAttr>::Output<Vec<crate::LeptosAttribute>>: IntoView,
98	{
99	    let id = id.map(Oco::into_owned);
100	
101	    children.into_inner()()
102	        .add_any_attr(AsChildAttrs::from(as_child_root_attrs(id, is_focusable)).into_inner())
103	}

  "content": "//! Regression tests for the explicit `class` prop on Leptos adapter\n//! components, and the `attr:` prefix pass-through for other attributes.\n//!\n//! Leptos's `attr:class` does NOT merge with a component-supplied internal\n//! class — it emits a second `class=` attribute, which browsers silently\n//! drop. To keep Tailwind/CSS-utility workflows working, every Leptos\n//! adapter component that owns a root element exposes an explicit `class`\n//! prop that pre-merges with the component's own class tokens in the\n//! `AttrMap` layer.\n\n#![cfg(all(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"), feature = \"ssr\"))]\n\nuse ars_leptos::utility::{\n    heading::{Heading, Level},\n    highlight::Highlight,\n    landmark::{Landmark, Role},\n    separator::Separator,\n    visually_hidden::VisuallyHidden,\n};\nuse leptos::{prelude::*, reactive::owner::Owner};\n\nfn render(view_fn: impl FnOnce() -> String + 'static) -> String {\n    let owner = Owner::new();\n    let result = owner.with(view_fn);\n    drop(owner);\n    result\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn heading_forwards_class_prop_to_root() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Heading id=\"x\" level=Level::Two class=\"text-4xl font-bold\">\n                \"Title\"\n            </Heading>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(\n        html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<h2\"),\n        \"expected h2 root: {html}\"\n    );\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"class=\"text-4xl font-bold\"\"#),\n        \"expected class on root: {html}\"\n    );\n    assert_eq!(\n        html.matches(\"class=\").count(),\n        1,\n        \"expected exactly one class= attribute: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_forwards_class_to_native_role_root() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Landmark id=\"n\" role=Role::Navigation class=\"sidebar-nav\">\"links\"</Landmark>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<nav\"));\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"class=\"sidebar-nav\"\"#),\n        \"expected class on nav root: {html}\"\n    );\n    assert_eq!(\n        html.matches(\"class=\").count(),\n        1,\n        \"expected exactly one class= attribute: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn landmark_forwards_class_to_search_fallback_div() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Landmark id=\"s\" role=Role::Search class=\"site-search\">\"input\"</Landmark>\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<div\"));\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"class=\"site-search\"\"#),\n        \"expected class on fallback div: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn highlight_forwards_class_to_root_span() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! {\n            <Highlight\n                query=vec![\"x\".to_string()]\n                text=\"hello\".to_string()\n                class=\"hl-root\"\n            />\n        }\n        .to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<span\"));\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"class=\"hl-root\"\"#),\n        \"expected class on highlight root: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn separator_forwards_class_to_hr_root() {\n    let html = render(|| {\n        view! { <Separator id=\"sep\" class=\"menu-divider\" /> }.to_html()\n    });\n\n    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with(\"<hr\"));\n    assert!(\n        html.contains(r#\"class=\"menu-divider\"\"#),\n        \"expected class on hr root: {html}\"\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn visually_hidden_merges_consumer_class_with_internal_class() {\n    // VisuallyHidden's non-focusable `<span>` already carries the\n    // `ars-visually-hidden` class. //! Probe: pre-merge consumer class with internal class at the `AttrMap`
//! layer before converting to Leptos attrs. Should emit a single `class=`.

#![cfg(all(not(target_arch = "wasm32"), feature = "ssr"))]

use ars_core::{AttrMap, AttrValue, HtmlAttr};
use ars_leptos::attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs;
use leptos::{prelude::*, reactive::owner::Owner};

fn merged_class(map: &AttrMap, user_class: Option<&str>) -> Option<String> {
    let existing = map
        .get(&HtmlAttr::Class)
        .map(std::string::ToString::to_string);

    match (existing, user_class) {
        (Some(internal), Some(user)) if !internal.is_empty() && !user.is_empty() => {
            Some(format!("{internal} {user}"))
        }
        (Some(internal), _) if !internal.is_empty() => Some(internal),
        (_, Some(user)) if !user.is_empty() => Some(user.to_owned()),
```

## Summary — Leptos `class` prop with proper merging

**Added a `class: Option<Oco<'static, str>>` prop to every Leptos adapter component that owns a rendered root**, plus a shared `merge_consumer_class_into` helper exported from `ars-leptos`.

**Components updated (Leptos):**

| Component | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `Heading` | new `class` prop; merges with no-op (no internal class) |
| `Landmark` | new `class` prop; merges with no-op (no internal class) |
| `Highlight` | new `class` prop; merges with no-op (no internal class) |
| `Separator` | new `class` prop on both `Separator` and `SeparatorAsChild`; no-op |
| `VisuallyHidden` | new `class` prop on both `VisuallyHidden` and `VisuallyHiddenAsChild`; **properly merges with the `ars-visually-hidden` internal class** |
| `Button` | existing `class` prop now **uses additive merge instead of clobber** (was a latent bug) |
| `Tabs` | new `class` prop on Tabs root `<div>`; merges with no-op |
| `Dismissable::Region` | new `class` prop; merges with no-op |

**How the merge works:**

The new `ars_leptos::merge_consumer_class_into(&mut AttrMap, Option<&str>)` helper:
1. Reads the existing `HtmlAttr::Class` value (if any) from the `AttrMap`.
2. Concatenates `"{component} {consumer}"` when both are non-empty.
3. Writes the merged value back to the `AttrMap` so the final conversion emits a *single* `class="…"` attribute.

This sidesteps Leptos's `attr:class` duplicate-attribute issue at the source.

**API parallelism with Dioxus:**

```rust
// Both adapters now accept the same call:
<Heading id="t" level=Level::Two class="text-4xl font-bold">"Title"</Heading>
```

For other attributes (data-*, aria-*, lang, …), Leptos consumers still use the `attr:foo` prefix (no internal conflict, no duplicate-attribute problem). Dioxus consumers use the `extends = GlobalAttributes` form natively.

**Validation:**

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p ars-leptos --features ssr --test attr_passthrough` | 7/7 pass (Heading, Landmark native/Search, Highlight, Separator, VisuallyHidden merge, attr:data-testid) |
| All other Leptos integration tests | 0 regressions |
| `cargo clippy -p ars-leptos --features ssr --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask e2e utility --adapter leptos` | pass |

1	//! Leptos `Heading` adapter.
2	//!
3	//! Renders the framework-agnostic [`Heading`](ars_components::utility::heading)
4	//! attribute contract as a semantic `<h1>`–`<h6>` element whose level resolves
5	//! from explicit props or the inherited [`HeadingContext`]. Ships alongside
6	//! [`HeadingLevelProvider`] and [`Section`] provider components so descendants
7	//! receive an updated `HeadingContext` without prop drilling.
8	
9	pub use ars_components::utility::heading::{
10	    Api, HeadingContext, Level, Part, Props, heading_level_provider, section,
11	};
12	use ars_core::{AttrValue, HtmlAttr};
13	use leptos::{either::EitherOf6, prelude::*};
14	
15	use crate::{attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs, merge_consumer_class_into};
16	
17	/// Reads the inherited heading level context, defaulting to [`HeadingContext::new`]
18	/// (level one) when no provider is in scope.
19	fn inherited_context() -> HeadingContext {
20	    use_context::<HeadingContext>().unwrap_or_default()
21	}
22	
23	/// Leptos `Heading` component.
24	///
25	/// Renders a semantic `<h1>`–`<h6>` element whose level is resolved from the
26	/// explicit `level` prop, the nearest [`HeadingContext`] published by
27	/// [`HeadingLevelProvider`] or [`Section`], or [`Level::One`] when no provider
28	/// is in scope.
29	#[component]
30	pub fn Heading(
31	    /// Optional component instance ID.
32	    #[prop(optional, into)]
33	    id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
34	
35	    /// Explicit heading level override; when absent, the nearest
36	    /// [`HeadingContext`] supplies the resolved level.
37	    #[prop(optional)]
38	    level: Option<Level>,
39	
40	    /// Consumer class tokens appended to the heading root. Use this for
41	    /// Tailwind utility chains or any other CSS class list — the tokens
42	    /// merge with whatever class the component itself emits so both reach
43	    /// the rendered `<h*>` as a single `class` attribute.
44	    #[prop(optional, into)]
45	    class: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
46	
47	    /// Heading content rendered inside the resolved tag.
48	    children: Children,
49	) -> impl IntoView {
50	    let id = id.map(Oco::into_owned);
51	    let class = class.map(Oco::into_owned);
52	
53	    let ctx = inherited_context();
54	
55	    let mut props = Props::new();
56	
57	    if let Some(id) = id.as_deref() {
58	        props = props.id(id);
59	    }
60	
61	    if let Some(level) = level {
62	        props = props.level(level);
63	    }
64	
65	    let api = Api::new(props, ctx);
66	
67	    let resolved = api.resolved_level();
68	
69	    let mut attrs = api.root_attrs(true);
70	
71	    if id.is_none() {
72	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, AttrValue::None);
73	    }
74	
75	    merge_consumer_class_into(&mut attrs, class.as_deref());
76	
77	    let attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(attrs);
78	
79	    match resolved {
80	        Level::One => EitherOf6::A(view! { <h1 {..attrs}>{children()}</h1> }),
81	        Level::Two => EitherOf6::B(view! { <h2 {..attrs}>{children()}</h2> }),
82	        Level::Three => EitherOf6::C(view! { <h3 {..attrs}>{children()}</h3> }),
83	        Level::Four => EitherOf6::D(view! { <h4 {..attrs}>{children()}</h4> }),
84	        Level::Five => EitherOf6::E(view! { <h5 {..attrs}>{children()}</h5> }),
85	        Level::Six => EitherOf6::F(view! { <h6 {..attrs}>{children()}</h6> }),
86	    }
87	}
88	
89	/// Leptos `HeadingLevelProvider` component.
90	///
91	/// Provider-only component that publishes a starting [`HeadingContext`] to its
92	/// descendants. Renders no DOM of its own.
93	#[component]
94	pub fn HeadingLevelProvider(
95	    /// Starting heading level to publish to descendants.
96	    level: Level,
97	
98	    /// Descendants that should observe the published [`HeadingContext`].
99	    children: Children,
100	) -> impl IntoView {
101	    let provider_props = heading_level_provider::Props::new().level(level);
102	
103	    provide_context(heading_level_provider::context_for(&provider_props));
104	
105	    children()
106	}
107	
108	/// Leptos `Section` component.
109	///
110	/// Provider-only component that publishes an incremented [`HeadingContext`] to
111	/// its descendants, clamped at [`Level::Six`]. Renders no DOM of its own.
112	#[component]
113	pub fn Section(
114	    /// Descendants that should observe the incremented [`HeadingContext`].
115	    children: Children,
116	) -> impl IntoView {
117	    let parent = inherited_context();
118	
119	    provide_context(section::context_for(&parent));
120	
121	    children()
122	}
123

1	//! Leptos `Landmark` adapter.
2	//!
3	//! Renders the framework-agnostic [`Landmark`](ars_components::utility::landmark)
4	//! attribute contract as a semantic landmark element selected from the
5	//! configured [`Role`], falling back to `<div role="…">` when no native
6	//! landmark element applies (currently only [`Role::Search`]).
7	
8	pub use ars_components::utility::landmark::{Api, Messages, Part, Props, Role};
9	use ars_core::{AttrValue, Env, HtmlAttr, Locale};
10	use leptos::{
11	    either::{Either, EitherOf7},
12	    prelude::*,
13	};
14	
15	use crate::{
16	    attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs, merge_consumer_class_into, resolve_locale, use_messages,
17	};
18	
19	/// Leptos `Landmark` component.
20	///
21	/// Renders a semantic landmark element (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`,
22	/// `<aside>`, `<footer>`, `<form>`, `<section>`) for the requested
23	/// [`Role`], or an explicit `<div role="search">` fallback when
24	/// [`Api::prefers_generic_fallback_element`] returns `true`. Resolves the
25	/// localized `aria-label` from `messages` (or the provider's message
26	/// registry when omitted) using the optional `locale` override or the
27	/// surrounding [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) locale.
28	#[component]
29	#[expect(
30	    clippy::needless_pass_by_value,
31	    reason = "Leptos #[component] requires props to be passed by value."
32	)]
33	pub fn Landmark(
34	    /// Optional component instance ID.
35	    #[prop(optional, into)]
36	    id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
37	
38	    /// Semantic landmark role. Defaults to [`Role::Region`].
39	    #[prop(optional)]
40	    role: Option<Role>,
41	
42	    /// Optional ID of an external element that labels this landmark. When
43	    /// set and non-empty, `aria-labelledby` takes precedence over the
44	    /// localized `aria-label`.
45	    #[prop(optional, into)]
46	    labelledby_id: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
47	
48	    /// Localized messages bundle. When omitted, the adapter resolves
49	    /// messages from the [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) message
50	    /// registry, falling back to [`Messages::default`] (empty label).
51	    #[prop(optional)]
52	    messages: Option<Messages>,
53	
54	    /// Locale override for resolving the `aria-label`. When absent, the
55	    /// surrounding [`ArsProvider`](crate::ArsProvider) locale is used.
56	    #[prop(optional)]
57	    locale: Option<Locale>,
58	
59	    /// Consumer class tokens appended to the landmark root. Merges with
60	    /// whatever class the component itself emits so both reach the rendered
61	    /// element as a single `class` attribute.
62	    #[prop(optional, into)]
63	    class: Option<Oco<'static, str>>,
64	
65	    /// Children rendered inside the landmark element.
66	    children: Children,
67	) -> impl IntoView {
68	    let id = id.map(Oco::into_owned);
69	    let labelledby_id = labelledby_id.map(Oco::into_owned);
70	    let class = class.map(Oco::into_owned);
71	    let resolved_role = role.unwrap_or(Role::Region);
72	    let mut props = Props::new().role(resolved_role);
73	
74	    if let Some(id) = id.as_deref() {
75	        props = props.id(id);
76	    }
77	
78	    if let Some(labelledby) = labelledby_id.as_deref() {
79	        props = props.labelledby_id(labelledby);
80	    }
81	
82	    let resolved_locale = resolve_locale(locale.as_ref());
83	    let resolved_messages = use_messages::<Messages>(messages.as_ref(), Some(&resolved_locale));
84	    let env = Env {
85	        locale: resolved_locale,
86	        ..Env::default()
87	    };
88	    let api = Api::new(props, &env, &resolved_messages);
89	    let is_native = !api.prefers_generic_fallback_element();
90	    let mut attrs = api.root_attrs(is_native);
91	
92	    if id.is_none() {
93	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, AttrValue::None);
94	    }
95	
96	    merge_consumer_class_into(&mut attrs, class.as_deref());
97	
98	    let attrs = attr_map_to_leptos_inline_attrs(attrs);
99	
100	    if is_native {
101	        Either::Right(match resolved_role {
102	            Role::Banner => EitherOf7::A(view! { <header {..attrs}>{children()}</header> }),
103	            Role::Navigation => EitherOf7::B(view! { <nav {..attrs}>{children()}</nav> }),
104	            Role::Main => EitherOf7::C(view! { <main {..attrs}>{children()}</main> }),
105	            Role::Complementary => EitherOf7::D(view! { <aside {..attrs}>{children()}</aside> }),
106	            Role::ContentInfo => EitherOf7::E(view! { <footer {..attrs}>{children()}</footer> }),
107	            Role::Form => EitherOf7::F(view! { <form {..attrs}>{children()}</form> }),
108	            Role::Region => EitherOf7::G(view! { <section {..attrs}>{children()}</section> }),
109	            Role::Search => {
110	                unreachable!("Role::Search is handled by Api::prefers_generic_fallback_element()")
111	            }
112	        })
113	    } else {
114	        Either::Left(view! { <div {..attrs}>{children()}</div> })
115	    }
116	}
117	
```

Everything compiles cleanly. Summary:

## TypedChildren refactor — done

**Components updated to use `TypedChildren<T>` instead of untyped `Children`:**

| Component | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `Heading` | `children: Children` | `children: TypedChildren<T>` where `View<T>: IntoView` |
| `HeadingLevelProvider` | `children: Children` | `children: TypedChildren<T>` where `View<T>: IntoView` |
| `Section` | `children: Children` | `children: TypedChildren<T>` where `View<T>: IntoView` |
| `Landmark` | `children: Children` | `children: TypedChildren<T>` where `View<T>: IntoView` |

`Highlight` doesn't have a children prop (it renders its own chunk output), and `Separator`/`VisuallyHidden`/`Button`/`Tabs`/`dismissable::Region` already used `TypedChildren<T>` before this work.

**Implementation notes:**

- For `Heading` and `Landmark`, which dispatch over `EitherOf6` / `EitherOf7`, the typed children closure is called once into a `body` binding *before* the match. Each arm then references `body` rather than calling `children()` directly — this avoids a potential FnOnce double-move under stricter generic typing.
- For the provider-only components (`HeadingLevelProvider`, `Section`), the body is `children.into_inner()()` — they delegate the typed view directly without wrapping.

**Why it matters:**

`TypedChildren<T>` preserves the concrete view type rather than erasing to `AnyView`, which:
- Keeps Leptos's reactive view diffing precise (per `TypedChildren` docs).
- Enables future use of `AddAnyAttr` on consumer trees if these components ever grow `AsChild` variants.
- Matches the convention already used by every other Leptos adapter component in the workspace.

**Validation:**

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo check -p ars-leptos --features ssr` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p ars-leptos --features ssr --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo test -p ars-leptos --features ssr --tests` | all binaries pass (0 failures) |
| `cargo check -p ars-e2e-fixture-leptos` | clean |
| `cargo check -p widgets-leptos -p widgets-leptos-css -p widgets-leptos-tailwind` | clean |

---
/* ars-base.css -- companion stylesheet for ars-core
 * Published alongside the ars-core crate. Include via a <link> element.
 */

/* Visually hidden but accessible to screen readers.
 * Used by: VisuallyHidden (non-focusable variant), LiveAnnouncer. */
.ars-visually-hidden {
    position: absolute !important;
    border: 0 !important;
    width: 1px !important;
    height: 1px !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: -1px !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    clip-path: inset(50%) !important;
    clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important;
    white-space: nowrap !important;
    word-wrap: normal !important;
}

/* Visually hidden until focus, for skip-link style affordances.
 * Used by: VisuallyHidden (focusable variant, when `is_focusable=true`). */
[data-ars-visually-hidden-focusable]:not(:focus):not(:focus-within) {
    position: absolute !important;
    border: 0 !important;
    width: 1px !important;
    height: 1px !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: -1px !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    clip-path: inset(50%) !important;
    clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important;
    white-space: nowrap !important;
    word-wrap: normal !important;
}

/* Screen-reader-only native input (hidden but participates in form submission).
 * Used by: RadioGroup hidden input, Switch hidden input, FileUpload hidden input. */
.ars-sr-input {
    position: absolute !important;
    width: 1px !important;
    height: 1px !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important;
}

/* Suppress browser touch gestures on drag targets.
 * Used by: Slider thumb, Splitter handle, use_move targets. */
.ars-touch-none {
    touch-action: none !important;
}

/* Print media reset — spec/foundation/03-accessibility.md §8.
 * Hide overlays, suppress focus rings, undo scroll-lock side-effects,
 * and remove portal content that is detached from its logical context.
 * Consumers who need to override these defaults (e.g., to show a
 * specific dialog in print) can use a higher-specificity selector or
 * additional @media print rules after this stylesheet. */
@media print {
    /* §8.1 — Hide overlays and backdrops (alertdialog remains visible). */
    [data-ars-scope="dialog"]:not([role="alertdialog"]),
    [data-ars-scope="drawer"],
    [data-ars-scope="popover"],
    [data-ars-scope="tooltip"],
    [data-ars-scope="toast"],
    [data-ars-backdrop] {
        display: none !important;
    }

    /* §8.3 — Remove scroll-lock side-effects. */
    html,
    body {
        overflow: visible !important;
        padding-right: 0 !important;
        height: auto !important;
    }

    /* §8.4 — Hide portal root (content should be inlined for print). */
    #ars-portal-root {
        display: none !important;
    }

    /* §8.2 — Suppress focus indicators. */
    [data-ars-focus-visible] {
        outline: none !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
    }

    /* Suppress loading spinners / skeleton screens. */
    [data-ars-state="loading"] {
        visibility: hidden;
    }
}

1	//! Regression tests for the `#[props(extends = GlobalAttributes)]` pass-through
2	//! on every Dioxus adapter component that owns its rendered root.
3	//!
4	//! These tests confirm that consumer-supplied `class`, `style`, `data-*`,
5	//! `aria-*` etc. flow onto the component root and that tokenized values
6	//! (`class`, `style`) concatenate with the component's own tokens rather than
7	//! clobbering them.
8	
9	#![cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]
10	
11	use ars_dioxus::utility::{
12	    heading::{Heading, Level},
13	    highlight::Highlight,
14	    landmark::{Landmark, Role},
15	    separator::Separator,
16	    visually_hidden::VisuallyHidden,
17	};
18	use dioxus::prelude::*;
19	
20	fn render_app(app: fn() -> Element) -> String {
21	    let mut vdom = VirtualDom::new(app);
22	    vdom.rebuild_in_place();
23	    dioxus_ssr::render(&vdom)
24	}
25	
26	#[test]
27	fn heading_forwards_class_and_data_attrs_to_root() {
28	    fn app() -> Element {
29	        rsx! {
30	            Heading {
31	                id: "h",
32	                level: Level::Two,
33	                class: "text-4xl font-bold",
34	                "data-testid": "title",
35	                "Title"
36	            }
37	        }
38	    }
39	
40	    let html = render_app(app);
41	
42	    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with("<h2"), "expected h2: {html}");
43	    assert!(
44	        html.contains(r#"class="text-4xl font-bold""#),
45	        "expected class on h2: {html}"
46	    );
47	    assert!(
48	        html.contains(r#"data-testid="title""#),
49	        "expected data-testid on h2: {html}"
50	    );
51	}
52	
53	#[test]
54	fn landmark_forwards_class_to_native_role_root() {
55	    fn app() -> Element {
56	        rsx! {
57	            Landmark { id: "n", role: Role::Navigation, class: "sidebar-nav", "links" }
58	        }
59	    }
60	
61	    let html = render_app(app);
62	
63	    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with("<nav"));
64	    assert!(
65	        html.contains(r#"class="sidebar-nav""#),
66	        "expected class on nav root: {html}"
67	    );
68	}
69	
70	#[test]
71	fn landmark_forwards_class_to_search_fallback_div() {
72	    fn app() -> Element {
73	        rsx! {
74	            Landmark { id: "s", role: Role::Search, class: "site-search", "input" }
75	        }
76	    }
77	
78	    let html = render_app(app);
79	
80	    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with("<div"));
81	    assert!(
82	        html.contains(r#"class="site-search""#),
83	        "expected class on search fallback div: {html}"
84	    );
85	}
86	
87	#[test]
88	fn highlight_forwards_class_to_root_span() {
89	    fn app() -> Element {
90	        rsx! {
91	            Highlight {
92	                query: vec!["x".to_string()],
93	                text: "hello",
94	                class: "hl-root",
95	            }
96	        }
97	    }
98	
99	    let html = render_app(app);
100	
101	    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with("<span"));
102	    assert!(
103	        html.contains(r#"class="hl-root""#),
104	        "expected class on highlight root span: {html}"
105	    );
106	}
107	
108	#[test]
109	fn separator_forwards_class_to_hr_root() {
110	    fn app() -> Element {
111	        rsx! {
112	            Separator { id: "sep", class: "menu-divider" }
113	        }
114	    }
115	
116	    let html = render_app(app);
117	
118	    assert!(html.trim_start().starts_with("<hr"));
119	    assert!(
120	        html.contains(r#"class="menu-divider""#),
121	        "expected class on hr root: {html}"
122	    );

125	#[test]
126	fn visually_hidden_merges_consumer_class_with_component_class() {
127	    // VisuallyHidden's `<span>` already carries the `ars-visually-hidden`
128	    // class. Consumer class tokens must concatenate, not clobber.
129	    fn app() -> Element {
130	        rsx! {
131	            VisuallyHidden { id: "v", class: "skip-link", "Hidden" }
132	        }
133	    }
134	
135	    let html = render_app(app);
136	
137	    assert!(
138	        html.contains("skip-link"),
139	        "expected consumer class present: {html}"
140	    );
141	    assert!(
142	        html.contains("ars-visually-hidden"),
143	        "expected component class still present: {html}"
144	    );
145	}
146	
147	#[test]
148	fn heading_data_ars_scope_wins_over_consumer_override() {
149	    // Ordinary (non-token) attributes prefer the component's value on
150	    // conflict — the component-managed `data-ars-scope` must not be
151	    // overridable by a consumer-supplied attribute.
152	    fn app() -> Element {
153	        rsx! {
154	            Heading { level: Level::Two, "data-ars-scope": "consumer-tried", "Title" }
155	        }
156	    }
157	
158	    let html = render_app(app);
159	
160	    assert!(
161	        html.contains(r#"data-ars-scope="heading""#),
162	        "component-managed data-ars-scope must survive: {html}"
163	    );
164	    assert!(
165	        !html.contains(r#"data-ars-scope="consumer-tried""#),
166	        "consumer override must NOT win on component-managed attrs: {html}"
167	    );
168	}

> DEVELOPER

What is this `COMPONENT_NAMED_ADAPTER_TEST_FILES` in the @xtask/src/lint.rs ?

> AGENT

It's a small allowlist used by the adapter-parity lint to recognize integration test files that don't follow the canonical `test_{component}_*.rs` naming.

**How it's used** (`xtask/src/lint.rs:412-421`):

```rust
let files = collect_files(dir, |path| {
    path.file_name()
        .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
        .is_some_and(|name| {
            (name.starts_with("test_") && name.ends_with(".rs"))
                || COMPONENT_NAMED_ADAPTER_TEST_FILES
                    .iter()
                    .any(|component| name == format!("{component}.rs"))
        })
})?;
```

`check_adapter_parity` counts `#[test]` / `#[wasm_bindgen_test]` functions per component in both `crates/ars-leptos/tests/` and `crates/ars-dioxus/tests/`, then asserts the two sides stay within a tolerance. It needs to know *which* `.rs` files to include. The canonical naming is `test_{component}_{whatever}.rs`, but older suites in this workspace landed as plain `{component}.rs` (e.g. `tests/separator.rs`, `tests/visually_hidden.rs`, `tests/heading.rs`, `tests/highlight.rs`, `tests/landmark.rs`). Rather than silently treating those zero-test files (which would trigger a parity failure on otherwise-tested components), they're explicitly admitted by name.

The comment on `lint.rs:14-15` calls this out:

> `// Component-named adapter integration tests admitted while older adapter suites migrate toward the canonical test_{component}_*.rs parity naming pattern.`

So it's a transitional allowlist — entries should be removed as suites are renamed to the canonical `test_*.rs` pattern. I added `heading`, `highlight`, and `landmark` here during the recent adapter work (the previous summary noted that), because those tests landed as `tests/heading.rs` etc. Once those are renamed to `test_heading_*.rs`, the entries can be dropped.

There's a regression test at `lint.rs:1128-1159` (`adapter_parity_counts_component_named_integration_tests`) that pins the behavior.

> DEVELOPER

Why not just use the canonical naming instead of increasing the allowlist?

> AGENT

Honestly, no good reason — I copied the existing pattern (`separator.rs`, `visually_hidden.rs`) for symmetry, but that just propagates the debt the allowlist comment explicitly says it's trying to retire. The cleaner move is to rename the new files (and ideally the pre-existing `separator`/`visually_hidden` ones too) to the canonical `test_{component}_*.rs` pattern, then drop the entire allowlist constant.

Tradeoff: ~10-12 file renames (5 components × leptos + dioxus + a few wasm variants), but it's pure churn — no code logic changes, and it lets us delete a chunk of `lint.rs` plus its regression test. Want me to do the rename pass in this PR while we're still touching these files?

> DEVELOPER

Yeah, move everything to the canonical naming and get rid of this allowlist
